Co-VLA: Coordination-Aware Structured Action Modeling for Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Systems Manipulation

Co-VLA dual-arm manipulation vision-language-action Structured Action Expert Latent-Aware Controller

简要说明：Co-VLA通过在VLA模型中引入显式结构先验，利用结构化动作专家和潜在感知控制器，提升双机械臂操作的协调性、可解释性和安全性。

TLDR: Co-VLA introduces explicit structural priors into VLA models for dual-arm manipulation, using a Structured Action Expert and a Latent-Aware Controller to improve coordination, interpretability, and safety.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong capabilities in single and dual-arm robotic manipulation. Prior works show coordinated bimanual behaviors can emerge from end-to-end learning, leveraging large vision-language backbones with continuous action prediction. However, as bimanual tasks become tightly coupled and execution constraints become critical, implicit coordination alone is insufficient to ensure reliable, interpretable, and stable behavior. In this work, we propose Co-VLA, a coordination-aware bimanual manipulation framework introducing explicit structural priors into VLA models. We instantiate our method on a state-of-the-art vision-language backbone by replacing its monolithic action head with a Structured Action Expert (SAE) designed for bimanual coordination. Specifically, we introduce explicit structure at the action generation level with a modular coordination-aware loss that shapes shared and residual latents according to task-specific structures. The shared latent encodes task-level coordination intent, while residual latents capture execution adjustments for each arm. At deployment, a Latent-Aware Controller (LAC) interprets the learned representations to modulate synchronization strength, execution asymmetry, smoothness, and safety constraints in real time. LAC operates at the joint-command level and remains compatible with standard control pipelines without requiring force or impedance control. Experiments across simulation and real-world benchmarks show Co-VLA significantly outperforms monolithic baselines, achieving a 27% success rate gain in tight-coordination tasks, more than doubling performance in OOD real-world scenarios (from 13% to 27%), and reducing task completion time by up to 25%.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在单臂与双臂机器人操作中展现出强大能力。已有研究表明，通过端到端学习，利用具备连续动作预测能力的大规模视觉-语言主干网络，可以涌现出协调的双臂行为。然而，随着双臂任务耦合程度加深且执行约束变得关键，仅依赖隐式协调不足以确保行为可靠、可解释且稳定。 为此，我们提出Co-VLA——一种面向协调感知的双臂操作框架，将显式结构先验引入VLA模型。我们基于当前最先进的视觉-语言主干网络实现该方法，用专为双臂协调设计的结构化动作专家（SAE）替代原有整体式动作头。具体而言，我们在动作生成层面引入显式结构：通过模块化的协调感知损失函数，根据任务特定结构塑造共享潜变量与残差潜变量。共享潜变量编码任务级协调意图，而残差潜变量则捕获各机械臂的执行调整量。 在部署阶段，延迟感知控制器（LAC）对学习到的表征进行解读，实时调节同步强度、执行不对称性、平滑度及安全约束。LAC在关节指令层级运行，与标准控制流水线兼容，无需依赖力控或阻抗控制。跨仿真与真实世界基准实验表明，Co-VLA显著优于整体式基线：在紧耦合协调任务中成功率提升27%，在真实世界分布外场景中性能翻倍以上（从13%提升至27%），任务完成时间最高缩短25%。

Authors: Yandong Wang, Jiaqian Yu, Xiongfeng Peng, Lu Xu, Yamin Mao, Weiming Li, Jaewook Yoo, Dongwook Lee, Daehyun Ji, Mingbo Zhao, Chao Zhang

Finetuning Vision-Language-Action Models Requires Fewer Layers Than You Think VLA

Vision-Language-Action models layer pruning structural compression robotic manipulation training-free compression

简要说明：本文揭示了大规模VLA模型中层级的表示冗余，并提出了一种无需训练的流水线，通过移除冗余层将模型深度压缩50%，在真实世界操作任务上训练时间减少40-50%、推理速度提升30%，性能持平或超越原始模型。

TLDR: This paper reveals layer-wise representational redundancy in large VLA models and proposes a training-free structural compression pipeline that removes redundant layers, achieving 40-50% reduction in training time and up to 30% faster inference while matching or exceeding full-scale performance on real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pre-trained on massive video-robot datasets have revolutionized robotic manipulation, yet their multi-billion parameter architectures impose prohibitive computational burdens during downstream fine-tuning and real-time inference. In this work, we reveal a highly non-trivial architectural characteristic of these continuous control foundation policies (e.g., pi_0, GR00T-N1.5): despite being trained on diverse physical trajectories, they exhibit severe layer-wise representational redundancy. To exploit this, we introduce a structural compression pipeline that is entirely training-free, bypassing the need of existing methods to load full-scale models to learn optimized token reductions or dynamic layer selectors. Instead, using only a single forward pass via Centered Kernel Alignment to identify redundant layer features, we remove twin layers to permanently compress the model depth by up to 50% across both the VLM backbone and the continuous control policy head. Downstream fine-tuning of this streamlined architecture yields a dual acceleration benefit: a 40-50% reduction in training time and up to 30% faster real-time inference, while matching or exceeding full-scale base model performance. We comprehensively validate our method across three simulation benchmarks (LIBERO, RoboCasa, SimplerEnv) and 10 diverse real-world manipulation tasks across 4 unique robotic embodiments. These results prove that advanced VLAs require significantly fewer layers than previously assumed, offering a highly compute-efficient paradigm for scalable robot learning.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在大量视频-机器人数据集上的预训练革新了机器人操作任务，然而其数十亿参数架构在下游微调与实时推理中造成了巨大的计算负担。本工作揭示了这些连续控制基础策略模型（如pi_0、GR00T-N1.5）一个高度非平凡的结构特性：尽管在多样化的物理轨迹上训练，它们仍表现出显著的逐层表征冗余。为利用这一特性，我们提出了一种完全无需训练的结构压缩流水线，避免了现有方法需加载完整模型以学习优化令牌缩减或动态层选择器的需求。取而代之的是，仅通过使用中心核对齐的单次前向传播来识别冗余层特征，我们移除孪生层，从而将VLM骨干网络及连续控制策略头的模型深度永久压缩至高50%。对该精简架构的下游微调提供了双重加速收益：训练时间减少40-50%，实时推理速度提升高达30%，同时性能持平或超越全尺寸基础模型。我们在三个仿真基准（LIBERO、RoboCasa、SimplerEnv）及横跨4种独特机器人平台的10项真实世界操作任务中全面验证了该方法。这些结果表明，先进VLA模型所需的层数远少于此前假设，为可扩展的机器人学习提供了一种高计算效率范式。

Authors: Gia-Binh Nguyen, Trong-Bao Ho, Thien-Loc Ha, Khoa Vo, Philip Lund Møller, Quang T. Nguyen, Long Dinh, Tuan Dam, Vu Duong, Tung M. Luu, Trung Le, Tran Nguyen Le, Minh Vu, An Thai Le, Ngan Le, Daniel Sonntag, James Zou, Jan Peters, Duy M. H. Nguyen, Ngo Anh Vien

World Engine: Towards the Era of Post-Training for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

generative framework post-training safety-critical scenarios autonomous driving end-to-end driving

简要说明：World Engine 通过生成式框架从真实日志重建高保真交互驾驶环境，外推出安全关键场景，用于自动驾驶策略的后训练，从而减少罕见事件中的失败并提升道路安全性。

TLDR: World Engine uses a generative framework to reconstruct high-fidelity interactive driving environments from real logs, extrapolating safety-critical scenarios for post-training autonomous driving policies, which reduces failures in rare events and improves on-road safety.

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles must operate safely in the real world, where errors can have severe consequences. Although modern end-to-end driving policies excel in routine scenarios, their reliability is limited by the scarcity of safety-critical ``long-tail'' events in real driving datasets. These rare interactions define the practical safety boundary of the learned policy, yet they are difficult to collect at scale in the real world. Here we show that this fundamental limitation can be addressed by post-training pre-trained driving models on synthesized high-stakes interactions. We introduce World Engine, a generative framework that reconstructs high-fidelity interactive environments from real-world logs and systematically extrapolates them into realistic safety-critical variations. This paradigm enables reinforcement-based post-training to align policies with safety constraints, circumventing the physical risks inherent in real-world exploration. On a public benchmark built on nuPlan, World Engine substantially reduces failures in rare safety-critical scenarios and yields significantly larger gains than scaling pre-training data alone. Furthermore, when deployed on a production-scale autonomous driving system, the resulting policy reduces simulated collisions and demonstrates measurable improvements in on-road testing, showing that post-training on synthesized, safety-critical interactions offers a scalable and effective pathway to safer autonomous driving. The full codebase suite, including training, is released to the public.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶车辆必须在现实中安全运行，而现实中的错误可能导致严重后果。尽管现代端到端驾驶策略在常规场景中表现出色，但其可靠性受到真实驾驶数据集中安全关键型"长尾"事件稀缺性的限制。这些罕见交互定义了学习策略的实际安全边界，但在现实世界中却难以大规模采集。本文表明，通过在高风险合成交互场景中对预训练驾驶模型进行后训练，可解决这一根本性局限。我们提出World Engine——一个从真实世界日志重建高保真交互环境，并系统化外推至逼真安全关键变体的生成式框架。该范式使基于强化学习的后训练能够将策略与安全约束对齐，从而规避现实探索中固有的物理风险。在基于nuPlan构建的公开基准测试中，World Engine显著减少了罕见安全关键场景的失败案例，其效果远超单纯扩展预训练数据规模。当部署至量产级自动驾驶系统时，该策略不仅降低了仿真碰撞率，还在道路测试中展现出可量化的性能提升——证明对合成安全关键交互进行后训练，为实现更安全的自动驾驶提供了可扩展的有效路径。包含训练模块的完整代码库已向公众开放。

Authors: Tianyu Li, Li Chen, Caojun Wang, Haochen Liu, Kashyap Chitta, Zhenjie Yang, Yuhang Lu, Naisheng Ye, Yihang Qiu, Yufei Wang, Luoxi Zou, Jiaxin Peng, Jin Pan, Zhaoyu Su, Andrei Bursuc, Shengbo Eben Li, Andreas Geiger, Peng Su, Hongyang Li

EquiVLA: A General Framework for Rotationally Equivariant Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

SO(2)-equivariant Vision-Language-Action flow-matching Diffusion Transformer robot manipulation rotation generalization

简要说明：EquiVLA 通过引入SO(2)等变视觉表示和等变流匹配扩散Transformer动作头，赋予VLA模型旋转几何归纳偏置，在机器人操作基准和真实任务中显著提升性能。

TLDR: EquiVLA introduces SO(2)-equivariant visual representations and an equivariant flow-matching Diffusion Transformer action head to endow VLA models with rotational geometric inductive biases, achieving significant improvements in robot manipulation across benchmarks and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for generalist robot manipulation, yet they lack geometric inductive biases: policies trained at specific orientations require substantially more data to generalize across rotational configurations. We present \textsc{EquiVLA}, the first general framework for end-to-end $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant VLA models, applicable to any architecture coupling a frozen vision-language backbone with a flow-matching Diffusion Transformer action head. \textsc{EquiVLA} introduces \textsc{EquiPerceptor}, which produces approximately $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant visual representations from frozen ViT features; and \textsc{EquiActor}, an exactly $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant flow-matching Diffusion Transformer action head. Together, they establish an approximate $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ equivariance chain from camera observations to predicted action sequences. Instantiated on GR00T~N1.5 and evaluated across four LIBERO suites, CALVIN ABCD$\to$D, and five real-robot tasks on Mobile ALOHA, \textsc{EquiVLA} achieves $92.6\%$ average success on LIBERO (vs. $78.1\%$ baseline), an average sequence length of $4.03$ on CALVIN (vs. $3.45$), and improves real-robot success from $54\%$ to $72\%$.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人操作的有力范式，但其缺乏几何归纳偏置：在特定方向训练的模型需要大量额外数据才能泛化至不同旋转配置。我们提出\textsc{EquiVLA}——首个面向端到端$\mathrm{SO}(2)$-等变VLA模型的通用框架，可适用于任何将冻结视觉-语言骨干网络与流匹配扩散Transformer动作头相结合的网络架构。\textsc{EquiVLA}引入\textsc{EquiPerceptor}，该模块能从冻结ViT特征中生成近似$\mathrm{SO}(2)$-等变的视觉表征；同时引入\textsc{EquiActor}，这是一个精确$\mathrm{SO}(2)$-等变的流匹配扩散Transformer动作头。两者共同构建了从相机观测到预测动作序列的近似$\mathrm{SO}(2)$等变链。基于GR00T~N1.5实现，并在四个LIBERO套件、CALVIN ABC$\to$D任务以及Mobile ALOHA上的五项真实机器人任务中评估，\textsc{EquiVLA}在LIBERO上达到平均$92.6\%$的成功率（基线为$78.1\%$），在CALVIN上达到平均序列长度$4.03$（基线为$3.45$），并将真实机器人任务成功率从$54\%$提升至$72\%$。

Authors: Thien-Loc Ha, Quang-Tan Nguyen, Trong-Bao Ho, Long Dinh, Minh Duc Nguyen, Gia-Binh Nguyen, Pham Tri Quang, Minh N. Vu, Duy M. H. Nguyen, An Thai Le, Ngo Anh Vien

Scaling Self-Play for End-to-End Driving AutonomousDriving

self-play end-to-end driving DAgger training high-throughput simulator privileged teacher distillation

简要说明：提出了一个高吞吐量模拟器（Gigapixel）和自对弈DAgger训练方法，从像素直接扩展端到端自动驾驶策略，无需人工轨迹监督即可在真实世界基准上取得竞争性表现。

TLDR: Proposes a high-throughput simulator (Gigapixel) and self-play DAgger training to scale end-to-end autonomous driving policies directly from pixels, achieving competitive performance on real-world benchmarks without human trajectory supervision.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving models are typically trained on offline human-demonstration datasets that provide limited state coverage and often no closed-loop feedback, making them prone to compounding errors when deployed in closed-loop and brittle to long-tail agent interactions. To overcome these limitations, we propose an alternative strategy for training end-to-end driving models: large-scale self-play directly from pixels in simulation. While prior self-play approaches have shown promising transfer to real-world driving, they typically assume vectorized Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) observations that are incompatible with end-to-end policies operating directly on sensor observations. To this end, we introduce Gigapixel, a high-throughput batched driving simulator with perspective rendering, enabling scalable self-play directly from pixel observations. Rather than targeting compute-costly photorealistic sensor simulation, Gigapixel renders a simplified bounding-box world that preserves essential scene structure while achieving throughput at 50k agent steps per second. Since direct pixel-space self-play RL is prohibitively sample-inefficient at end-to-end model scale, we propose self-play DAgger training: we train pixel-based policies in self-play via on-policy distillation from a privileged RL teacher. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we subsequently transfer the self-play trained policies to real-world sensor data through lightweight perception adaptation. Policies trained in Gigapixel and adapted to real-world sensor data achieve competitive performance on the HUGSIM and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks without human trajectory supervision. Moreover, scaling self-play training yields proportional gains in policy performance, establishing self-play as a practical and scalable strategy for training end-to-end models.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶模型通常基于离线的人类驾驶演示数据集进行训练，这类数据集提供的状态覆盖范围有限，且往往缺乏闭环反馈机制，导致模型在闭环部署时容易出现累积误差，并且对长尾交互场景的鲁棒性较差。为克服这些局限，我们提出一种替代训练策略：直接在像素级仿真中进行大规模自博弈训练。尽管先前的自博弈方法已展现出向真实驾驶场景迁移的潜力，但它们通常依赖矢量化的鸟瞰图观测，这与直接处理传感器观测的端到端策略不兼容。为此，我们提出Gigapixel——一种具备透视渲染能力的高通量批处理驾驶模拟器，支持基于像素观测的可扩展自博弈训练。与追求高算力的逼真传感器仿真不同，Gigapixel通过渲染简化的包围盒世界，在保留关键场景结构的同时，实现了每秒5万个智能体步长的高吞吐量。鉴于直接在像素空间进行自博弈强化学习在端到端模型规模下样本效率极低，我们提出自博弈DAgger训练方法：通过在线策略蒸馏，从具有特权信息的强化学习教师模型中学习像素级策略。为弥合仿真与现实的差距，我们随后通过轻量级感知适配将自博弈训练策略迁移至真实传感器数据。在Gigapixel中训练并适配真实传感器数据的策略，在HUGSIM与NAVSIM-v2基准测试中无需人类轨迹监督即可取得与现有方法相当的竞争性表现。此外，扩大自博弈训练规模可带来策略性能的同比提升，证实自博弈是一种训练端到端模型的实用且可扩展策略。

Authors: Luke Rowe, Roger Girgis, Rodrigue de Schaetzen, Daphne Cornelisse, Alaap Grandhi, Felix Heide, Eugene Vinitsky, Christopher Pal, Liam Paull

ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing? VLA

World Action Model image editing robot action prediction efficiency flow-matching action expert

简要说明：ImageWAM 将预训练的图像编辑模型重新用于机器人动作预测，以显著更低的计算成本实现了与基于视频的世界动作模型相当的性能。

TLDR: ImageWAM repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction, achieving performance comparable to video-based world action models with significantly lower computational cost.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We propose ImageWAM, a simple WAM framework that repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. In contrast to video generation, image editing provides a better-matched prior: it only needs to model a target-frame transformation, focuses on action-relevant current-to-target visual differences, and grounds task instructions to localized visual changes through edit pretraining. In practice, ImageWAM does not decode the target frame at inference time; instead, it conditions a flow-matching action expert on the KV caches produced by image-editing denoising, using them as a compact world-action context. ImageWAM outperforms standard VLA baselines and matching competitive WAMs without additional policy pretraining across different simulator and real-world experiments. It also reduces FLOPs to 1/6 and latency to 1/4 of video-based WAMs. Attention analysis further shows that editing caches focus on task-relevant change regions, supporting image editing as an effective alternative to video-based world-action modeling.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通常依赖视频生成来连接视觉世界建模与机器人控制。然而，基于视频的WAMs面临三个相互关联的局限：密集的多帧未来标记导致推理成本高昂，完整的视频预测将模型容量消耗在与动作无关的时间与外观细节上，且长时域的未来想象可能引入误导动作预测的误差。这些问题引出一个简单疑问：世界动作模型真的需要视频生成吗？我们提出ImageWAM——一个简洁的WAM框架，该框架将预训练的图像编辑模型重新用于机器人动作预测。与视频生成相比，图像编辑提供了更匹配的先验信息：它只需建模目标帧的变换，聚焦于当前帧到目标帧中与动作相关的视觉差异，并通过编辑预训练将任务指令锚定到局部视觉变化上。实际应用中，ImageWAM在推理时无需解码目标帧；相反，它以图像编辑去噪过程产生的KV缓存为条件，驱动一个流匹配动作专家模型，将这些缓存作为紧凑的世界动作上下文。在多个仿真与真实世界实验中，ImageWAM超越了标准VLA基线模型，并能与需要额外策略预训练的竞争性WAMs相匹敌。同时，其FLOPs降低至基于视频的WAMs的1/6，延迟降低至1/4。注意力分析进一步表明，编辑缓存聚焦于任务相关的变化区域，从而验证图像编辑可作为基于视频的世界动作建模的有效替代方案。

Authors: Yuyang Zhang, Wenyao Zhang, Zekun Qi, He Zhang, Haitao Lin, Jingbo Zhang, Yao Mu, Xiaokang Yang, Wenjun Zeng, Xin Jin

ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World Manipulation

dexterous manipulation coding agents closed-loop policy improvement real-world robot learning autonomous policy refinement

简要说明：ENPIRE 提出了一个闭环框架，利用编码代理在现实世界中自主改进机器人操作策略，在灵巧任务上实现了高成功率，且只需极少的人工监督。

TLDR: ENPIRE introduces a closed-loop framework that uses coding agents to autonomously refine robot manipulation policies in the real world, achieving high success rates on dexterous tasks with minimal human supervision.

Abstract: Achieving dexterous robotic manipulation in the real world heavily relies on human supervision and algorithm engineering, which becomes a central bottleneck in the pursuit of general physical intelligence. Although emerging coding agents can generate code to automate algorithm search, their successes remain largely confined in digital environments. We conjecture that the missing abstraction to automate robotics research is a repeatable feedback loop for real-world policy improvement: reset the scene, execute a policy, verify the outcome, and refine the next iteration. To bridge this gap, we introduce ENPIRE, a harness framework for coding agents that instantiates this physical feedback routine with four core modules: an Environment module (EN) for automatic reset and verification, a Policy Improvement module (PI) that launches policy refinement, a Rollout module (R) to evaluate policies with one or multiple physical robots operating in parallel, and an Evolution module (E) in which coding agents analyze logs, consult literature, improve training infrastructure and algorithm code to address failure modes. This closed-loop system transforms real-world manipulation learning into a controllable optimization procedure, minimizing human effort while allowing fair ablations across training recipe and agent variants. Powered by ENPIRE, frontier coding agents can autonomously train a policy to achieve a 99% success rate on challenging, dexterous manipulation tasks, such as organizing a pin box, fastening a zip tie, and tool use, a process that further accelerates when we dispatch an agent team on a robot fleet. Our results suggest a practical and scalable path toward deploying coding agents to autonomously advancing robotics in the physical world.

摘要（中文）：在现实世界中实现灵巧的机器人操控高度依赖于人类监督和算法工程，这成为追求通用物理智能的核心瓶颈。尽管新兴的编程智能体能够生成代码以自动化算法搜索，但其成功仍主要局限于数字环境。我们推测，自动化机器人研究缺失的抽象层是一个可重复的真实世界策略改进反馈循环：重置场景、执行策略、验证结果并优化下一次迭代。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出ENPIRE——一个面向编程智能体的框架，通过四个核心模块实例化这一物理反馈循环：环境模块（EN）负责自动重置与验证、策略改进模块（PI）启动策略优化、部署模块（R）通过一台或多台并行运行的物理机器人评估策略、进化模块（E）中编程智能体分析日志、查阅文献、改进训练基础设施与算法代码以应对失效模式。这一闭环系统将真实世界的操控学习转化为可控的优化流程，在最小化人力投入的同时，支持对训练方案与智能体变体进行公平消融实验。依托ENPIRE，前沿编程智能体能够自主训练策略，在针盒整理、扎带紧固及工具使用等挑战性灵巧操控任务上实现99%的成功率——当我们在机器人集群中部署智能体团队时，这一进程将进一步加速。我们的研究结果为在物理世界中部署编程智能体以实现机器人研究的自主演进，指出了一条切实可行且可扩展的路径。

Authors: Wenli Xiao, Jia Xie, Tonghe Zhang, Haotian Lin, Letian "Max" Fu, Haoru Xue, Jalen Lu, Yi Yang, Cunxi Dai, Zi Wang, Jimmy Wu, Guanzhi Wang, S. Shankar Sastry, Ken Goldberg, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Yuke Zhu, Guanya Shi

MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory Manipulation

world action model persistent memory robotic manipulation hybrid memory design long-horizon tasks

简要说明：MemoryWAM 通过混合持久记忆机制（结合近期帧、事件边界锚帧和紧凑摘要令牌）实现了高效的长时序记忆依赖机器人操作。

TLDR: MemoryWAM introduces a hybrid persistent memory mechanism for world action models, combining recent frames, anchor frames, and gist tokens to enable efficient long-horizon memory-dependent robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Robust robotic manipulation in the real world requires not only an understanding of the current observation, but also memory and dynamics modeling. World action models (WAMs) possess these capabilities by jointly modeling visual foresight and actions conditioned on both current and historical observations, making them a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, existing WAMs face a fundamental trade-off: methods with efficient inference typically condition only on a bounded window of recent observations and therefore struggle in non-Markovian environments, whereas methods that preserve long histories incur time and space costs that grow substantially with sequence length. To address this challenge, we introduce MemoryWAM, a world action model with efficient persistent memory. MemoryWAM uses a hybrid memory design that combines recent frames, event-boundary anchor frames, and compact gist tokens that summarize long-range history. A tailored attention mechanism enables retrieval of both detailed short-term context and compressed long-term context, supporting memory-dependent decision-making with reduced inference latency and GPU memory usage. Across long-horizon, memory-dependent manipulation tasks in both simulation and the real world, MemoryWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines while maintaining favorable computational efficiency.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 现实世界中的鲁棒机器人操作不仅需要理解当前观测，还需要具备记忆与动力学建模能力。世界动作模型通过联合建模视觉前瞻与基于当前及历史观测的动作，具备上述能力，因此成为机器人操作领域具有前景的范式。然而，现有世界动作模型面临根本性权衡：高效推理的方法通常仅依赖有限窗口内的近期观测，因此在非马尔可夫环境中表现不佳；而保留长历史信息的方法则会导致时间与空间成本随序列长度显著增长。为应对这一挑战，我们提出MemoryWAM——一种具有高效持久记忆的世界动作模型。MemoryWAM采用混合记忆设计，结合近期帧、事件边界锚点帧以及压缩长程历史信息的紧凑要旨标记。通过定制化的注意力机制，模型能够同时检索细节短期上下文与压缩长期上下文，在降低推理延迟与GPU内存占用的同时支持依赖记忆的决策。在仿真与现实世界中涉及长程、依赖记忆的操作任务中，MemoryWAM在保持有利计算效率的同时，显著优于强视觉-语言-动作基线与世界动作模型基线。

Authors: Sizhe Yang, Juncheng Mu, Tianming Wei, Chenhao Lu, Xiaofan Li, Linning Xu, Zhengrong Xue, Zhecheng Yuan, Dahua Lin, Jiangmiao Pang, Huazhe Xu

Generating Robot Hands from Human Demonstrations Manipulation

robot hand design human demonstrations fingertip tracking data-driven optimization print-in-place joints

简要说明：该工作提出了一种数据驱动框架，利用人类指尖运动数据优化并生成机器人手部设计，无需联合搜索设计与控制，并在真实世界中展示了高精度遥操作追踪。

TLDR: This work presents a data-driven framework that uses human fingertip motion data to optimize and generate robot hand designs, eliminating the need for joint design-control search and demonstrating real-world teleoperated tracking.

Abstract: Robot learning has advanced rapidly in learning control, but learning the physical body of a robot remains much more difficult because jointly searching over design and control creates a very large combinatorial problem. Here, we present a data-driven framework for generating robot hands from human demonstrations. Instead of learning a complex controller together with each candidate design, we generate robot hand designs using the same simple control policy used after fabrication: matching fingertip positions through inverse kinematics. Using more than 4 million frames of human fingertip motion from everyday manipulation, our algorithm optimizes tree-structured robot hands to reproduce desired target motions. The framework produced both a 6-degree-of-freedom (DoF) general-purpose hand and lower-DoF task-specific hands with spatial four-bar mimic joints. To accelerate the search over designs, we trained a reinforcement-learning (RL) actor to propose good hand designs and joint angles, reducing search time from hours to minutes. We fabricated the mechanisms directly as one-piece articulated structures with print-in-place joints. In real-world experiments, the 6-DoF hand achieved highly accurate teleoperated fingertip tracking better than available commercial robot hands, whereas the specialized 3-DoF hands reproduced structured human and synthetic trajectories with reduced mechanical complexity. These results showed that large-scale human motion data can be used not only to train robot controllers but also as a reference for optimizing and generating the physical embodiment of robots.

摘要（中文）：机器人学习在控制领域取得了快速进展，但学习机器人的物理本体仍然困难得多，因为对设计与控制的联合搜索构成了一个非常庞大的组合问题。本文提出了一种基于数据驱动的框架，通过人类示教来生成机器人手部。我们并非针对每个候选设计学习复杂的控制器，而是采用与制造后相同的简单控制策略——通过逆运动学匹配指尖位置——来生成机器人手部设计。该算法利用来自日常操作的超过400万帧人类指尖运动数据，优化树形结构机器人手部以复现所需的目标运动。该框架不仅生成了一个6自由度（DoF）的通用型手部，还生成了具有空间四杆仿生关节的低自由度专用手部。为加速设计搜索，我们训练了一个强化学习（RL）智能体来推荐优质手部设计与关节角度，将搜索时间从数小时缩短至数分钟。这些机构直接以带有原位打印关节的一体化铰接结构制造。在真实世界实验中，6自由度手部实现了精度优于现有商用机器人手部的高保真遥操作指尖追踪，而专用3自由度手部则以更低的机械复杂度复现了结构化的人类与合成轨迹。这些结果表明，大规模人体运动数据不仅能用于训练机器人控制器，还可作为优化与生成机器人物理本体的参考依据。

Authors: Sha Yi, Nicklas Hansen, Xueqian Bai, Carmelo Sferrazza, Michael T. Tolley, Xiaolong Wang

GroundControl: Anticipating Navigation Failures in Vision-Language Agents via Trajectory-Consistent Uncertainty Estimates VLN

trajectory-consistent uncertainty Kalman filter vision-language navigation selective risk-coverage failure anticipation

简要说明：GroundControl 提出了一种轨迹一致性不确定性估计方法，通过卡尔曼滤波器建模与目标导向距离动态的偏差，来检测视觉-语言导航智能体中的振荡或停滞等故障，在SRCN协议上优于基于熵的基线方法。

TLDR: GroundControl introduces a trajectory-consistent uncertainty estimator for vision-language navigation agents that detects failures like oscillation or stagnation by modeling deviation from goal-directed distance dynamics using a Kalman filter, outperforming entropy-based baselines on the SRCN protocol.

Abstract: Vision-language navigation agents achieve competitive average success on benchmark tasks, yet failures often arise through predictable trajectory-level breakdowns such as oscillation, stagnation, or inefficient detours. Reliable deployment, therefore, requires uncertainty signals that anticipate emerging failure dynamics during execution rather than reflect only instantaneous action entropy. We introduce \emph{GroundControl}, a trajectory-consistent uncertainty estimator defined as statistical deviation from nominal goal-directed distance-to-goal dynamics aggregated over an episode. GroundControl models distance evolution using a constant-velocity Kalman filter and combines normalized innovation statistics with complementary trajectory features capturing progress, monotonicity, path efficiency, and oscillatory behavior. The resulting uncertainty score reflects geometric and temporal inconsistency in navigation behavior rather than local prediction dispersion. To evaluate uncertainty quality independently of task success, we formalize \emph{Selective Risk--Coverage Navigation (SRCN)}, a protocol that measures how effectively an uncertainty score ranks episodes by failure or inefficiency using risk--coverage curves and AURC / E-AURC summaries. Across five EB-Navigation splits ($N=300$ episodes), trajectory-consistent uncertainty achieves near-oracle ordering under success-based selective risk, with weighted-average $\mathrm{E\text{-}AURC}_{\mathrm{SR}}=0.0024$ for the GPT-4o model, substantially outperforming entropy-, conformal-, and heuristic baselines. Under SPL-based selective evaluation, GroundControl consistently achieves the lowest AURC and E-AURC across models and navigation splits. These results show that modeling deviation from goal-directed dynamics provides an interpretable and robust signal for anticipating navigation failures in vision-language agents.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航智能体在基准任务中取得了具有竞争力的平均成功率，但失败往往源于可预测的轨迹级故障，例如震荡、停滞或低效绕路。因此，可靠部署需要能够在执行过程中预判新兴故障动态的不确定性信号，而非仅反映瞬时动作熵。我们提出\emph{GroundControl}，一种轨迹一致性不确定性估计器，定义为在一个回合中聚合的、与名义目标导向距离-目标动态的统计偏差。GroundControl使用恒定速度卡尔曼滤波器对距离演化进行建模，并将归一化的创新统计量与捕捉进度、单调性、路径效率和震荡行为的补充轨迹特征相结合。所得不确定性分数反映导航行为中的几何与时间不一致性，而非局部预测离散度。为独立于任务成功率评估不确定性质量，我们形式化\emph{选择性风险-覆盖导航（SRCN）}协议，该协议通过风险-覆盖曲线及AURC/E-AURC汇总指标，衡量不确定性分数根据失败或低效程度对回合进行排序的有效程度。在五个EB-Navigation分割（$N=300$个回合）中，基于成功率的选择性风险下，轨迹一致性不确定性实现了接近最优的排序，GPT-4o模型的加权平均$\mathrm{E\text{-}AURC}_{\mathrm{SR}}=0.0024$，显著优于基于熵、共形及启发式基线。在基于SPL的选择性评估中，GroundControl在不同模型和导航分割下均一致取得最低的AURC和E-AURC值。这些结果表明，对目标导向动态偏离的建模可为预判视觉-语言智能体的导航失败提供可解释且稳健的信号。

Authors: Nastaran Darabi, Divake Kumar, Sina Tayebati, Devashri Naik, Amit Ranjan Trivedi

Slow Brain, Fast Planner: Latency-Resilient VLM-Augmented Urban Navigation VLN

trajectory scoring gap VLM-Planner interface latency-resilient fusion sidewalk navigation anchor-based planner

简要说明：一种无需训练的VLM-规划器接口，利用VLM从实时规划器的候选轨迹集中选择轨迹，并通过几何相似性与指数衰减进行融合以处理延迟，改善了具有挑战性的场景中的人行道导航。

TLDR: A training-free VLM-Planner interface that uses a VLM to select candidate trajectories from a real-time planner's proposal set, fused via geometric similarity with exponential decay to handle latency, improving sidewalk navigation in challenging scenarios.

Abstract: Learning-based planners for sidewalk navigation can generate diverse candidate trajectories in real time, yet their scoring functions often fail to select the best trajectory in challenging situations, outputting trajectories that make the mobile robot drive onto grass, toward pedestrians, or in the wrong direction, even when better candidates exist in the same set. We call this the trajectory scoring gap: in real-world sidewalk navigation, the gap between an anchor-based planner's top choice and the best possible candidate is substantial, likely due to limited high-level scene understanding capability of the planner. Rather than replacing the planner with an end-to-end Vision-Language-Action model, we propose a VLM-Planner interface that uses a VLM to select a candidate index from the planner's proposal set and then fuse it with the planner's initial output. However, VLMs take 1--3s per query and so cannot directly drive a 5--20Hz control loop. We contribute a training-free, latency-resilient trajectory-level fusion layer that turns a stale VLM selection into real-time planner scoring via geometric similarity with exponential decay. On $\sim$2,000 challenging real-world scenarios (e.g., junctions, pedestrian encounters), VLM selection achieves 30% ADE reduction versus the planner's best selection, while the planner remains competitive in routine situations. In simulation, Score Fusion maintains >80% success rate with delays up to 5s. We demonstrate the full system on a mobile robot navigating challenging campus sidewalks with varied network latency.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的 sidewalk 导航规划器能够实时生成多样化的候选轨迹，但其评分函数在复杂场景下往往无法选出最优轨迹，导致移动机器人驶入草地、靠近行人或朝错误方向移动——即便同一候选集中存在更好的轨迹。我们将此称为轨迹评分鸿沟：在实际 sidewalk 导航中，基于锚点的规划器的最优选择与候选集中最佳轨迹之间存在显著差距，这很可能源于规划器对高层场景理解能力的不足。本文并未采用端到端的视觉-语言-动作模型替代规划器，而是提出了一种 VLM-规划器接口：通过视觉语言模型（VLM）从规划器的候选集中选择轨迹索引，并将其与规划器的初始输出融合。然而，VLM 每次查询需耗时 1-3 秒，无法直接驱动 5-20Hz 的控制循环。为此，我们贡献了一种无需训练、对延迟鲁棒的轨迹级融合层——通过基于指数衰减的几何相似度，将过时的 VLM 选择结果实时转化为规划器评分。在约 2,000 个复杂真实场景（如路口、行人交汇）中，VLM 选择相比规划器最优选择实现了 30% 的均方根误差（ADE）降低，而规划器在常规场景中仍保持竞争力。仿真实验中，评分融合在高达 5 秒的延迟下仍维持 80% 以上的成功率。我们还在移动机器人上实现了完整的系统，使其在存在网络延迟变化的校园 sidewalk 复杂环境中成功导航。

Authors: Zhenghao "Mark'' Peng, Honglin He, Quanyi Li, Yukai Ma, Bolei Zhou

CoLI: A Reproducible Platform for Continuum Robot Learning via Monolithic 3D Printing and Isomorphic Teleoperation Manipulation

continuum robot monolithic 3D printing isomorphic teleoperation imitation learning open-source

简要说明：一种采用整体3D打印和同构遥操作的新型开源连续体机器人平台，简化了制造和控制，并支持模仿学习。

TLDR: A novel open-source continuum robot platform using monolithic 3D printing and isomorphic teleoperation to simplify fabrication and control, with support for imitation learning.

Abstract: Continuum robots offer strong potential for manipulation tasks due to their high degrees of freedom, compliant structures, and operational safety. However, their adoption in both research and practical applications has been hindered by reproducibility issues arising from complex fabrication and assembly processes, challenging kinematic modeling, and a lack of intuitive control interfaces. To address these challenges, we present a novel open-source continuum robot design. The platform features a simplified fabrication pipeline enabled by multi-material 3D printing, allowing the arm to be fabricated as a monolithic compliant structure with minimal assembly. Control is achieved through an isomorphic teleoperation interface that establishes a direct actuator-level mapping, eliminating the need for explicit kinematic modeling and providing a singularity-free mapping. Building on this hardware design, the platform further supports imitation-learning-based autonomous control. The proposed system is evaluated through hardware characterization and a set of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the platform provides a reproducible, learning-ready continuum robot system, accelerating algorithmic development and systematic benchmarking for the continuum robotics community.

摘要（中文）：连续体机器人因其高自由度、柔性结构及操作安全性，在操控任务中展现出巨大潜力。然而，复杂的制造与装配流程、具有挑战性的运动学建模以及缺乏直观的控制界面所导致的可重复性问题，一直制约着其在研究及实际应用中的推广。为解决上述挑战，我们提出了一种新型开源连续体机器人设计。该平台采用多材料3D打印技术构建了简化的制造流程，使得机械臂能够以最小化装配的形式制成整体柔性结构。通过同构遥操作界面实现控制，该界面建立了直接执行器级的映射关系，无需显式运动学建模，并消除了奇异点映射问题。基于此硬件设计，该平台进一步支持基于模仿学习的自主控制。我们通过硬件特性测试及系列操控任务对该系统进行了评估。实验结果表明，该平台提供了一种具备可重复性且适用于学习的连续体机器人系统，能够加速连续体机器人领域的算法开发与系统化基准测试。

Authors: Ziyuan Tang, Chenxi Xiao*

Autonomous Driving with Priority-Ordered STL Specifications Under Multimodal Uncertainty AutonomousDriving

Signal Temporal Logic Model Predictive Path Integral uncertainty-aware trajectory planning priority ordering autonomous driving

简要说明：提出了一种用于自动驾驶的不确定性感知轨迹规划框架，该框架使用信号时序逻辑规约的字典序优先级排序，并通过模型预测路径积分控制实现。

TLDR: Proposes an uncertainty-aware trajectory planning framework for autonomous driving that uses lexicographic priority ordering over Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and implements it with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control.

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles must plan trajectories that satisfy a multitude of requirements on safety, passenger comfort, and compliance with traffic rules. However, in safety-critical scenarios, it is not always possible to satisfy all requirements simultaneously, necessitating their prioritization based on importance. At the same time, in these safety-critical scenarios, the uncertainty in trajectory predictions of the surrounding traffic, such as other vehicles and pedestrians, should be explicitly accounted for. In this work, we propose an uncertainty-aware trajectory planning framework that incorporates a predefined lexicographic ordering over Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications that stays valid under uncertainty. We implement this formulation with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control and we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on simulation scenarios, showing that our framework efficiently handles conflicting objectives under realistic multi-modal uncertainty.

摘要（中文）：自主车辆必须规划满足安全性、乘客舒适度及交通规则遵守等多重要求的轨迹。然而在安全关键场景中，同时满足所有要求往往不可行，需根据重要性对其进行优先级排序。同时，在这些安全关键场景中，应明确考虑周围交通参与者（如其他车辆和行人）轨迹预测的不确定性。本研究提出一种不确定性感知的轨迹规划框架，该框架在信号时序逻辑（STL）规范中融入预定义的词典序优先级，并在不确定性条件下保持有效性。我们通过模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制实现该方案，并在仿真场景中验证了方法的有效性，结果表明所提框架能够高效处理冲突目标下的多源不确定性。

Authors: Taha Bouzid, Shuhao Qi, Mircea Lazar, Sofie Haesaert

FlowMaps: Modeling Long-Term Multimodal Object Dynamics with Flow Matching VLN

flow matching object dynamics multimodal distribution object navigation spatio-temporal modeling

简要说明：FlowMaps利用潜在流匹配来预测3D中物体的多模态未来位置，利用人类日常活动的时空模式，提升机器人在动态家庭环境中的物体导航能力。

TLDR: FlowMaps uses latent flow matching to predict multimodal future object locations in 3D, leveraging spatio-temporal patterns from human routines to improve robotic object navigation in dynamic household environments.

Abstract: Joint spatial and temporal understanding of 3D scenes is a crucial requirement for robots deployed in everyday household environments. Such agents must not only comprehend and navigate spatial layouts, but also reason about how these spaces evolve over time. In particular, humans interact with objects daily, causing them to change position throughout the environment and making it difficult for robots to reliably associate current observations with previously seen objects. However, these interactions are not random: human habits and routines induce spatio-temporally consistent patterns in object locations, which robotic agents can potentially learn and then exploit for downstream tasks such as navigation. To this end, we introduce FlowMaps, a latent flow matching model for estimating multimodal distributions over the future locations of dynamic objects in a continuous 3D space. By learning the implicit dependencies among objects and their temporal evolution, FlowMaps predicts likely changes in object locations conditioned on past human interactions, while supporting generalization across previously unseen environments that share similar object routines. To demonstrate the utility of this method, we deploy FlowMaps in a downstream dynamic Object Navigation task in both simulated and real-world environments. Across more than 600 episodes, FlowMaps outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, showing that modeling object dynamics through continuous, multimodal spatio-temporal distributions improves robotic search and navigation in changing household environments. Code and additional material is available at https://fra-tsuna.github.io/flowmaps/.

摘要（中文）：对三维场景的联合时空理解是部署在日常家庭环境中的机器人所面临的一项关键需求。这类智能体不仅需要理解和导航空间布局，还需推理这些空间随时间如何演变。特别地，人类每日与物体互动，导致物体在环境中移动位置，使机器人难以将当前观察可靠地关联到先前见过的物体。然而，这些互动并非随机：人类的习惯与日常行为会在物体位置上形成具有时空一致性的模式，机器人智能体可以学习这些模式，进而将其用于导航等下游任务。为此，我们提出FlowMaps——一种潜在流匹配模型，用于估计连续三维空间中动态物体未来位置的多模态分布。通过学习物体间的隐式依赖关系及其时间演化，FlowMaps能够基于过去的人类互动预测物体位置的合理变化，同时支持泛化至具有相似物体习惯的未见环境。为展示该方法的应用价值，我们在模拟和真实环境中将其部署至动态物体导航下游任务。在超过600个实验轮次中，FlowMaps优于现有最先进方法，表明通过连续性多模态时空分布建模物体动态，能够提升机器人在变化家庭环境中的搜索与导航能力。代码与补充资料见https://fra-tsuna.github.io/flowmaps/。

Authors: Francesco Argenziano, Miguel Saavedra-Ruiz, Sacha Morin, Charlie Gauthier, Daniele Nardi, Liam Paull

HilDA: Hierarchical Distillation with Diffusion for Advancing Self-Supervised LiDAR Pre-trainin AutonomousDriving

self-supervised pretraining LiDAR knowledge distillation vision foundation models occupancy diffusion

简要说明：HilDA 提出了一种自监督激光雷达预训练框架，通过分层蒸馏视觉基础模型和时序占用扩散目标，提升自动驾驶中的3D感知能力。

TLDR: HilDA proposes a self-supervised LiDAR pretraining framework that uses hierarchical distillation from vision foundation models and a temporal occupancy diffusion objective to improve 3D perception for autonomous driving.

Abstract: Leveraging Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) for camera-to-LiDAR knowledge distillation offers a promising solution to the scarcity of annotated data needed to represent the immense geometric and kinematic diversity of real-world autonomous driving (AD). However, current approaches typically treat VFMs as black-box teachers, relying exclusively on frame-wise feature similarity. Consequently, they do not fully exploit the teacher's layer-wise semantic structure and global context, as well as the rich spatiotemporal information inherent in LiDAR sequences. We propose HilDA, a self-supervised pretraining framework for LiDAR backbones that better captures the semantic what and geometric where needed for driving tasks. HilDA combines hierarchical distillation comprising multi-layer distillation for progressive semantic alignment and global context distillation for scene-level semantics, with a temporal occupancy diffusion objective promoting spatiotemporal consistency. Models pre-trained with HilDA achieve state-of-the-art results on cross-modal distillation benchmarks and outperform models trained via prior distillation approaches on 3D object detection, scene flow, and semantic occupancy prediction. Code available at: https://maxiuw.github.io/hilda.

摘要（中文）：利用视觉基础模型（VFM）进行相机到激光雷达的知识蒸馏，为解决真实世界自动驾驶（AD）中因几何与运动多样性导致的标注数据稀缺问题提供了有效方案。然而，现有方法通常将VFM视为黑箱教师，仅依赖逐帧特征相似性进行学习，未能充分利用教师模型中逐层语义结构、全局上下文信息以及激光雷达序列固有的丰富时空特征。本文提出HilDA——一种面向激光雷达骨干网络的自监督预训练框架，能够更有效地捕捉驾驶任务所需的语义内容（what）与几何位置（where）。该框架通过层级蒸馏策略，结合用于渐进语义对齐的多层蒸馏与用于场景级语义理解的全局上下文蒸馏，并引入时序占用扩散目标以增强时空一致性。经HilDA预训练的模型在跨模态蒸馏基准测试中取得最优结果，并在三维目标检测、场景流估计及语义占用预测任务上全面超越采用先前蒸馏方法训练的模型。代码地址：https://maxiuw.github.io/hilda。

Authors: Maciej Wozniak, Jesper Ericsson, Hariprasath Govindarajan, Truls Nyberg, Thomas Gustafsson, Patric Jensfelt, Olov Andersson

Frequency-Aware Flow Matching for Continuous and Consistent Robotic Action Generation Manipulation

flow matching action generation frequency domain temporal consistency robotic manipulation

简要说明：FAFM 通过在频域中进行流匹配并结合平滑性约束，从异构频率的演示中生成连续且时间一致的机器人动作。

TLDR: FAFM uses frequency-domain flow matching with a Sobolev-type smoothness constraint to generate continuous, temporally consistent robot actions from heterogeneous-frequency demonstrations.

Abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a standard paradigm for robotic manipulation owing to its strong expressive power for modelling complex, multimodal action distributions, alongside similar approaches like diffusion policy. However, existing methods rely on discretized action chunks, making them brittle to demonstrations collected at heterogeneous control frequencies and prone to temporally inconsistent actions that degrade control stability. In this paper, we propose Frequency-Aware Flow Matching (FAFM), which outputs continuous, temporally consistent actions. To handle heterogeneous frequency input, we transform discrete action sequences into the frequency domain with the discrete cosine transform (DCT), perform flow matching over the resulting coefficients, and reconstruct continuous actions via cosine basis expansion. To generate temporally consistent actions, we regularize the first-order temporal derivative to promote smooth actions. This corresponds to a Sobolev-type constraint that suppresses high-frequency errors and discourages abrupt action changes. Our FAFM is simple, introduces no additional network parameters and applies to standalone flow-matching policies and vision-language action models. Across synthetic toy benchmark, obstacle avoidance, LapGym, and LIBERO, FAFM improves success rates, multimodal expressivity, motion smoothness, convergence speed, robustness to mechanical bias and mixed-frequency input. These gains are consistent when deployed on a real-world Franka robot. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FAFM.

摘要（中文）：流匹配因其在建模复杂多模态动作分布时表现出的强大表达能力，与扩散策略等类似方法一同，已成为机器人操作领域的一种标准范式。然而，现有方法依赖于离散化的动作块，使其对以异构控制频率收集的演示数据变得脆弱，并且容易产生时间不一致的动作，从而降低控制稳定性。本文提出频率感知流匹配（FAFM），该方法能够输出连续且时间一致的动作。为处理异构频率输入，我们通过离散余弦变换（DCT）将离散动作序列转换至频域，对所得系数执行流匹配，并通过余弦基展开重建连续动作。为生成时间一致的动作，我们对一阶时间导数进行正则化以促进动作平滑。这相当于施加一种索博列夫型约束，用以抑制高频误差并阻止动作突变。我们的FAFM方法简洁、不引入额外网络参数，并可应用于独立流匹配策略及视觉-语言动作模型。在合成玩具基准测试、避障、LapGym与LIBERO等任务中，FAFM提升了成功率、多模态表达能力、运动平滑度、收敛速度、对机械偏差及混合频率输入的鲁棒性。在实际Franka机器人上的部署结果也一致显示了这些优势。代码见：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FAFM。

Authors: Jianing Guo, Fangzheng Chen, Zihao Mao, Wong Lik Hang Kenny, Zhenhong Wu, Yu Li, Yishuai Cai, Yuanpei Chen, Yikun Ban, Kai Chen, Qi Dou, Yaodong Yang, Xianglong Liu, Huijie Zhao, Simin Li

Pose6DAug: Physically Plausible Multi-view Object Swapping for Robot Data Augmentation VLA

data augmentation multi-view consistency 6D pose trajectory VLA generalization object swapping

简要说明：Pose6DAug是一个故障驱动的数据增强框架，通过3D中对象交换和时序一致6D姿态生成物理上合理的多视角演示，无需新数据收集即可提升VLA策略在新物体上的成功率16.5%。

TLDR: Pose6DAug is a failure-driven data augmentation framework that swaps objects in 3D with temporally coherent 6D poses to generate physically plausible multi-view demonstrations for VLA policies without new data collection, improving success rates on novel objects by 16.5%.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have shown strong potential for general-purpose manipulation, yet they often fail on novel, out-of-distribution objects whose appearance or geometry deviates from the training distribution. The standard remedy is to collect multi-view teleoperation data for every failure case, but this scales poorly in both cost and time. We introduce Pose6DAug, a failure-driven data augmentation framework that turns a policy's own successful episodes into targeted demonstrations for its failure modes, without any new data collection. Our key insight is that each successful episode already encodes a physically valid action trajectory together with calibrated multi-view observations. By swapping only the manipulated object while preserving this trajectory, we obtain new and physically grounded demonstrations. However, naive 2D video editing breaks multi-view consistency and physical plausibility, particularly under heavy occlusion and egocentric viewpoints. Our method instead operates directly in 3D, anchoring the target object with an explicit mesh driven by a temporally coherent 6D pose trajectory, ensuring geometrically consistent renderings across all camera views. Fine-tuning a VLA on data augmented by our method improves success rates by 16.5% relative to the state-of-the-art baseline on novel objects, while preserving in-distribution performance. These results show that multi-view and physically consistent augmentation is a practical path to scalable VLA generalization.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在通用操作任务中展现出强劲潜力，但当面对外观或几何形状偏离训练分布的新型分布外物体时，往往表现不佳。常规解决方案是为每个失败案例收集多视角遥操作数据，但这种方式在成本和时间上的扩展性较差。我们提出Pose6DAug——一种故障驱动数据增强框架，无需任何新数据采集，即可将策略自身的成功回合转化为针对其失败模式的目标化演示。其核心洞察在于：每个成功回合已编码了物理可行的动作轨迹与标定过的多视角观测数据。通过仅替换操作对象而保留轨迹，我们获得了全新的、具有物理基础的演示。然而，朴素的二维视频编辑会破坏多视角一致性与物理合理性，尤其在严重遮挡和第一人称视角场景下。我们的方法直接作用于三维空间，利用时间连贯的六自由度（6D）姿态轨迹驱动显式网格锚定目标物体，确保所有相机视角下几何一致的渲染效果。在基于本方法增强数据上微调VLA策略，其在新型物体上的成功率相较当前最优基线提升16.5%，同时保持分布内性能不变。这些结果表明，多视角且物理一致的数据增强是实现策略泛化的实用路径。

Authors: Jonghoon Lee, Seong Hyeon Park, Byungwoo Jeon, Minha Lee, Jinwoo Shin

MirrorDuo: Reflection-Consistent Visuomotor Learning from Mirrored Demonstration Pairs Manipulation

visuomotor learning data augmentation behavior cloning diffusion policy reflection-equivariant

简要说明：MirrorDuo 提出一种反射一致性框架，能从单个 RGB-D 录制的演示中自动生成镜像演示对，在不增加人工成本的情况下有效翻倍数据量，用于模仿学习和扩散策略等视觉运动策略训练。

TLDR: MirrorDuo proposes a reflection-consistency framework that generates mirrored demonstration pairs from single RGB-D recordings, effectively doubling the data budget for visuomotor policy learning (behavior cloning, diffusion policy) without extra human effort.

Abstract: Image-based behaviour cloning leverages demonstrations captured from ubiquitous RGB cameras. However, it remains constrained by the cost of collecting diverse demos, especially for generalizing across workspace variations. We propose MirrorDuo, a reflection-based formulation that operates on image, proprioception, and full 6-DoF end-effector action tuples, generating a mirrored counterpart for each original demonstration, effectively achieving "collect one, get one for free". It can be applied as a data augmentation strategy for existing learning pipelines, such as standard behaviour cloning or diffusion policy, or as a structural prior for reflection-equivariant policy networks. By leveraging the overlap between the original and mirrored domains, MirrorDuo achieves significantly improved performance under the same data budget when demonstrations are evenly distributed across both sides of the workspace. When demonstrations are confined to one side, MirrorDuo enables efficient skill transfer to the mirrored workspace with as few as zero or five demos in the target arrangement.

摘要（中文）：基于图像的模仿学习利用了来自通用RGB摄像头采集的演示数据。然而，这种方法仍受限于采集多样化演示的成本，尤其是在跨工作空间变化进行泛化时。我们提出MirrorDuo，一种基于反射机制的方案，该方案处理图像、本体感知和完整六自由度末端执行器动作元组，为每个原始演示生成镜像副本，有效实现"采集一次，免费获得一次"。该方案可作为数据增强策略应用于现有学习流程（如标准行为克隆或扩散策略），也可作为反射等变策略网络的结构先验。通过利用原始域与镜像域之间的重叠，当演示在空间两侧均匀分布时，Mirduo在相同数据预算下实现了显著更优的性能。当演示仅局限于单侧时，MirrorDuo仅需目标布局中零至五个演示样本即可实现向镜像工作空间的高效技能迁移。

Authors: Zheyu Zhuang, Ruiyu Wang, Giovanni Luca Marchetti, Florian T. Pokorny, Danica Kragic

SWAP: Symmetric Equivariant World-Model for Agile Robot Parkour RLRobot

equivariant symmetric world model legged locomotion parkour zero-shot transfer geometric generalization

简要说明：SWAP 提出了一种等变对称世界模型，将左右对称性直接嵌入到世界模型和演员-评论家网络中，实现了创纪录的四足跑酷性能和对未见地形的鲁棒零样本泛化。

TLDR: SWAP introduces an equivariant symmetric world model that embeds left-right symmetry directly into the world model and actor-critic networks, enabling record-breaking quadruped parkour performance and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen terrains.

Abstract: While latent world models enable the proactive predictions required for extreme parkour, their purely data-driven nature forces them to redundantly encode left-right symmetric interactions as independent patterns. This inflates the learning burden and hinders the capture of geometric regularities, restricting the latent space's efficiency for downstream policies. To address this, we propose SWAP, an end-to-end equivariant symmetric world model. This framework embeds symmetry directly into both the world model and the actor-critic networks. In real-world tests, the robot leaps across a 2.13 m gap and climbs a 1.63 m platform, breaking records for quadruped parkour. Furthermore, the framework exhibits robust geometric generalization to unseen mirrored terrains and exceptional zero-shot transferability across diverse outdoor environments. These results demonstrate that symmetry equivariance is an effective structural prior for pushing the physical boundaries of learned legged locomotion.

摘要（中文）：潜世界模型虽能实现极限跑酷所需的主动预测能力，但其纯数据驱动的本质迫使其将左右对称交互作为独立模式进行冗余编码，这不仅加重了学习负担，更阻碍了几何规则性的捕获，从而限制了潜空间对下游策略的效率。为此，我们提出SWAP——一种端到端等变对称世界模型。该框架将对称性直接嵌入世界模型与演员-评论家网络。在真实世界测试中，机器人跨越了2.13米间隙并攀上1.63米平台，刷新了四足跑酷纪录。此外，该框架展现出对未知镜像地形的强几何泛化能力，以及在多样户外环境中卓越的零样本迁移性能。这些结果表明，对称等变性是推动学习型腿式运动突破物理极限的有效结构先验。

Authors: Kaixin Lan, Ze Wang, Hongyi Li, Lei Jiang, Chaojie Fu, Chengkai Su, Choi Lam Wong, Yongbin Jin, Hongtao Wang

Start Right, Arrive Right: Asynchronous Execution via Initial Noise Selection Manipulation

action chunking flow-based policy asynchronous execution noise selection real-world manipulation

简要说明：本文提出PAINT方法，通过为基于流的动作分块策略选择合适的初始噪声，实现无延迟的异步执行，无需修改策略或重新训练，并在12个仿真和6个真实世界操作任务上验证了有效性，涵盖单臂、双臂和人形机器人。

TLDR: This paper proposes PAINT, a training-free method that selects appropriate initial noise for flow-based action chunking policies, achieving asynchronous execution without delays or policy modification, and validates it on 12 simulated and 6 real-world manipulation tasks across single-arm, bimanual, and humanoid robots.

Abstract: Action chunking enables robot policies to produce temporally coherent behavior, but generating multi-step action sequences with flow-based policies incurs latency that is incompatible with real-time control. Under asynchronous execution, the robot continues executing the current chunk while the next one is generated, causing even minor delays to create inconsistencies at chunk boundaries. Existing methods address this problem by steering generation toward the already executed action prefix. We instead show that prefix consistency can be achieved by selecting an appropriate initial noise before generation begins, allowing the unmodified flow ODE to produce a coherent next chunk. This reframes asynchronous inference as a noise selection problem rather than a trajectory steering problem. We introduce \textbf{PAINT}, a training-free method that finds this noise via backward Euler inversion and constructs the final chunk through a repainting rule. In summary, \texttt{PAINT} requires no gradients, retraining, or policy modification; yet it improves execution consistency and task performance across \textit{12 simulated benchmarks} and \textit{6 real-world manipulation tasks} spanning single-arm, bimanual, and humanoid embodiments. Website: ~\href{https://paint-action-chunking.github.io}{\texttt{https://paint-action-chunking.github.io}}.

摘要（中文）：动作分组使得机器人策略能够产生时间一致性行为，但基于流的方法生成多步动作序列会引入延迟，无法满足实时控制需求。在异步执行场景下，机器人会在生成下一动作分组的同时继续执行当前分组，即使是微小延迟也会在分组边界处造成不一致。现有方法通过引导生成过程朝向已执行的动作前缀来解决该问题。相反，我们证明可以通过在生成开始前选择合适的初始噪声来实现前缀一致性，从而使未经修改的流常微分方程能够生成连贯的下一分组。这将异步推理重新定义为噪声选择问题而非轨迹引导问题。我们提出\textbf{PAINT}——一种无需训练的方法，通过后向欧拉逆变换寻找该噪声，并借助重绘规则构建最终分组。总结而言，\texttt{PAINT}不需要梯度计算、重新训练或策略修改，却能提升执行一致性和任务性能——在涵盖单臂、双臂及人形机器人形态的\textit{12个模拟基准测试}与\textit{6个真实世界操作任务}中均得到验证。网站：~\href{https://paint-action-chunking.github.io}{\texttt{https://paint-action-chunking.github.io}}。

Authors: Trong-Bao Ho, Quang-Tan Nguyen, Thien-Loc Ha, Gia-Binh Nguyen, Viet-Thanh Nguyen, Long Dinh, Minh N. Vu, Duy M. H. Nguyen, An Thai Le, Ngo Anh Vien

VOiLA: Vectorized Online Planning with Learned Diffusion Model for POMDP Agents RLRobot

POMDP diffusion model online planning sim-to-real GPU parallelization

简要说明：提出一种通过条件扩散模型学习POMDP模型并将其蒸馏以支持GPU并行在线规划的框架，在机器人任务中实现高效仿真到现实迁移，且仅需少量训练数据。

TLDR: Proposes a framework that learns POMDP models via conditional diffusion and distills them for GPU-parallelized online planning in robotics, achieving efficient sim-to-real transfer with limited data.

Abstract: Planning under uncertainty is an essential capability for autonomous robots. The Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) provides a powerful framework for such a capability. Although POMDP-based planning has advanced significantly, its application to real-world problems is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining faithful POMDP models. We present Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents (VOiLA), a framework that learns task-agnostic POMDP models for online planning under uncertainty. VOiLA learns transition and observation samplers using conditional diffusion models and learns observation-likelihood models for particle-based belief updates. To enable efficient online planning, the diffusion samplers are distilled into compact feedforward generators and integrated with Vectorized Online POMDP Planner (VOPP), an online POMDP planner designed to leverage GPU parallelization. Experimental results indicate the distillation strategy reduces sampling cost by up to nearly three orders of magnitude, making learned generative POMDP models practical for online planning. Evaluation of VOiLA on three benchmark problems indicate that VOiLA achieves equal or better performance than Recurrent Soft Actor Critic while using less than 10% training data, and generalizes much better to unseen environment configurations. Physical robot evaluation indicates VOiLA uses the models learned using only simulated data and generates a policy that successfully accomplish the task in 10 of 10 runs.

摘要（中文）：不确定性环境下的规划是自主机器人的一项关键能力。部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）为实现这一能力提供了强大的框架。尽管基于POMDP的规划方法取得了显著进展，但获取可靠的POMDP模型的困难常限制其在真实世界问题中的应用。我们提出VOiLA（面向POMDP智能体的扩散模型学习型向量化在线规划框架），该框架通过学习任务无关的POMDP模型，实现在不确定性环境下的在线规划。VOiLA利用条件扩散模型学习转移与观测采样器，并学习用于粒子滤波器信念更新的观测似然模型。为实现高效的在线规划，扩散采样器被蒸馏为紧凑的前馈生成器，并与专为GPU并行化设计的在线POMDP规划器（VOPP）集成。实验结果表明，蒸馏策略使采样成本降低近三个数量级，使学习型生成式POMDP模型可用于在线规划。在三个基准问题上的评估显示，VOiLA使用不到10%的训练数据即可达到或超越循环柔性演员-评论家方法的性能，且对未见环境配置具有更强的泛化能力。实体机器人评估表明，VOiLA仅使用仿真数据学习的模型，在10次运行中均能成功生成策略完成目标任务。

Authors: Marcus Hoerger, Rishikesh Joshi, Rahul Shome, Ian Manchester, Hanna Kurniawati

Bidirectional Tutoring for Developmental Motor Learning in Robots: Co-Developed Interaction Dynamics Support Stable Learning HumanoidEmbodied

bidirectional tutoring developmental motor learning free-energy principle generative replay humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出一种双向教学框架用于机器人动作学习，教师与学习者动态适应彼此，并在人形机器人操作任务上实验证明这种共适应互动比单向演示产生更一致的行为模式和更好的泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper proposes a bidirectional tutoring framework for robot motor learning, where tutor and learner dynamically adapt to each other, and demonstrates that such co-adaptive interaction yields more consistent behavioral patterns and better generalization than unidirectional demonstration on a humanoid robot manipulation task.

Abstract: Infants are well known to develop their motor skills through dense interaction with caregivers. Although such social interaction is crucial for human development, motor-skill learning in robots is often treated as a unidirectional process in which robots passively receive demonstrations from tutors. This overlooks a key property of social interaction: it is inherently bidirectional, with tutor and learner dynamically adapting to each other. In such interactions, the robot's past experiences may function as prior constraints that shape the dynamics of their co-developed trajectories. We hypothesize that bidirectional tutoring allows such constraints to guide the formation of consistent behavioral patterns that preserve behavioral coherence and support generalization, whereas unidirectional interaction lacks such constraints and leads to broader, less consistent behavioral patterns. To examine this hypothesis, we conducted two experiments with a physical humanoid robot performing an object manipulation task: one involving human-robot interaction and another employing an AI tutor interacting with the real robot through an adaptive intervention mechanism designed to examine whether similar effects would emerge under more controlled conditions. We implement the developmental learning framework using a free-energy-principle-based neural network extended with generative replay, which supports stable sequence-by-sequence learning from single tutored episodes. Across both settings, bidirectional tutoring fostered consistent behaviors and stage-wise generalization, while the robot gradually required less tutor guidance. These results suggest that bidirectional tutoring, as an embodied and socially grounded approach, provides an effective scaffold for developmental motor learning in robots.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 众所周知，婴幼儿通过与照护者的密集互动来发展运动技能。尽管这种社会互动对人类发展至关重要，但机器人运动技能学习通常被视为一种单向过程——机器人被动接受教导者的示范。这忽视了社会互动的一个关键特性：其本质是双向的，教导者与学习者会动态地相互适应。在这种互动中，机器人过往的经验可能作为先验约束，塑造其与教导者共同发展的轨迹动态。我们假设：双向教导能使这类约束引导出一致性行为模式的形成，从而保持行为连贯性并支持泛化；而单向互动则缺乏此类约束，导致更宽泛、不一致的行为模式。为检验这一假设，我们使用实体人形机器人执行物体操控任务，开展了两项实验：一项涉及人机互动，另一项采用人工智能教导者通过自适应干预机制与真实机器人互动，以在更受控的条件下检验是否会出现类似效应。我们基于自由能原理扩展了带有生成回放的神经网络，实现了发育学习框架，支持从单次教导序列中进行稳定的逐序列学习。在两种实验条件下，双向教导均促进了行为一致性与阶段性泛化，同时机器人对教导者指导的需求逐渐减少。这些结果表明，双向教导作为一种具身化且基于社会互动的方法，为机器人发育性运动学习提供了有效的支架。

Authors: Rui Fukushima, Jun Tani

CTS-MoE: Implicit Terrain Adaptation via Mixture-of-Experts for Perceptive Locomotion Locomotion

mixture-of-experts perceptive locomotion multi-task reinforcement learning teacher-student training terrain adaptation

简要说明：提出一种基于混合专家架构的感知运动控制方法，通过感知门控和多批评者实现自适应地形行走，无需高层选择器。

TLDR: Proposes a mixture-of-experts actor with perception-based gating and multi-critic for perceptive legged locomotion, enabling adaptive terrain traversal without a high-level selector.

Abstract: Perceptive legged locomotion over discontinuous terrain (e.g., stairs, gaps, and obstacles) requires adaptive behavior, as a single conservative gait cannot produce the anticipatory maneuvers needed for abrupt topology changes. Cast as multi-task reinforcement learning, this problem introduces a tension between sharing and separation. Tasks use a common locomotion base but have conflicting rewards, so a policy must share behavior while avoiding value interference. Prior work addresses only one side, with monolithic policies sacrificing specialization and hierarchical sub-policies sacrificing generalization across transitions and unseen terrain. We propose CTS-MoE, which combines a dense mixture-of-experts actor with perception-based gating to compose shared behaviors and a multi-critic with task-specific value heads to prevent interference. The model is trained end-to-end in a single-stage concurrent teacher-student setup that handles partial observability and avoids sequential distillation, with task labels used only during training. At deployment, routing depends solely on perception, allowing terrain adaptation without a high-level selector or terrain classifier. Experiments on a Unitree Go1 in simulation and on hardware across seen and unseen terrains show task-aware specialization, with lower tracking error and higher success rates than monolithic baselines. Project Website: https://cts-moe.github.io/ .

摘要（中文）：不连续地形（如楼梯、缝隙和障碍物）上的感知性腿部运动需要自适应行为，因为单一的保守步态无法应对突发地形变化所需的预期性动作。将该问题建模为多任务强化学习时，会引发共享与分离之间的张力。不同任务共享相同的运动基础，但奖励函数相互冲突，因此策略需要在避免价值干扰的同时共享行为。先前的工作仅处理了上述一方面：单一策略牺牲了特化能力，而分层子策略则牺牲了跨过渡阶段和未知地形的泛化能力。我们提出CTS-MoE，该方法结合了基于密集混合专家（MoE）的智能体与基于感知的门控机制以整合共享行为，并采用包含任务特定价值头的多评论家网络以防止干扰。模型在单阶段并行的师生设置中以端到端方式训练，可处理部分可观测性问题并避免顺序蒸馏，任务标签仅在训练阶段使用。部署时，路由选择完全依赖感知信息，无需高层选择器或地形分类器即可实现地形适应。在宇树Go1机器人上进行的仿真实验以及涵盖已知与未知地形的硬件实验表明，该方法具有任务感知的特化能力，相比单一基线方法实现了更低的跟踪误差和更高的成功率。项目网站：https://cts-moe.github.io/。

Authors: Francisco Affonso, Matheus P. Angarola, Ana Luiza Mineiro, Aditya Potnis, Marcelo Becker, Girish Chowdhary

Proprioceptive Invariant State Estimation for Humanoid Robots on Non-Inertial Ground HumanoidEmbodied

invariant extended Kalman filter state estimation humanoid robots non-inertial ground proprioceptive sensing

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于在非惯性地面上的人形机器人的不变扩展卡尔曼滤波方法，仅利用本体感知实现状态估计，在收敛速度和精度上取得显著提升。

TLDR: This paper presents an invariant extended Kalman filtering approach for real-time state estimation of humanoid robots on non-inertial ground using only proprioceptive sensing, achieving significant improvements in convergence speed and accuracy.

Abstract: This paper presents an invariant extended Kalman filtering (InEKF) approach for real-time state estimation of humanoid robots operating on non-inertial ground using only onboard proprioceptive sensing. The proposed approach estimates the robot's base position and velocity relative to the moving ground frame without requiring direct measurements of ground motion or externally mounted sensors. By exploiting kinematic constraints at the stance foot through foot-mounted IMUs, the filter accounts for ground-induced nonlinearities in the process and measurement models while remaining fully proprioceptive. The estimator is formulated to admit a right-invariant measurement model, enabling favorable error dynamics under large initial uncertainties. Observability analysis establishes conditions under which the robot's relative base position and velocity are observable with respect to the non-inertial ground frame. Experiments with the Digit humanoid robot standing and squatting atop a swaying and pitching ground showcase a 96% speedup in convergence rate and an 80% reduction in position estimate errors over existing InEKFs. Walking experiments on a uni-axially rotating ground achieve an average estimation error of less than 9 cm for an initial error of up to 1 m.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（InEKF）方法，用于在非惯性地面上运行的仿人机器人仅利用本体感知进行实时状态估计。该方法无需直接测量地面运动或安装外部传感器，即可估计机器人相对于移动地面的基座位置和速度。通过在支撑足处安装足部惯性测量单元（IMU）利用运动学约束，滤波器在处理和测量模型中纳入了地面引起的非线性特性，同时保持完全本体感知。该估计器被构造为具有右不变测量模型，从而在大初始不确定性下实现有利的误差动态特性。可观性分析建立了在非惯性地面参考系中机器人相对基座位置和速度可观测的条件。在晃动与俯仰地面上进行Digit仿人机器人站立与下蹲实验的结果表明，与现有InEKF相比，收敛速度提升96%，位置估计误差减少80%。在单轴旋转地面上进行的行走实验中，对于高达1米的初始误差，平均估计误差小于9厘米。

Authors: Falak Mandali, Zijian He, Yan Gu

See-and-Reach: Precise Vision-Language Navigation for UAVs within the Field of View VLN

UAV-VLN vision-language navigation 3D waypoint prediction target-visible navigation spatial direction alignment

简要说明：提出了一种目标可见的导航任务和基于动态3D方向线索的3DG-VLN框架，用于无人机在视野内的精准视觉语言导航，成功率提升了13.82%。

TLDR: Introduces a target-visible navigation task and a 3DG-VLN framework with dynamic 3D direction cues for precise UAV vision-language navigation within the field of view, achieving significant improvement in success rate.

Abstract: UAV Vision-Language Navigation (UAV-VLN) is typically formulated as a holistic search-and-reach problem, where long-range target discovery and final target approach are optimized and evaluated jointly. This formulation makes it difficult to assess a critical capability of aerial embodied agents, namely whether a UAV can accurately ground a visible target and translate vision-language evidence into precise 3D motion once the target enters its field of view. To address this limitation, we introduce UAV-VLN-FOV, a target-visible navigation task that isolates the see-and-reach stage and enables a more diagnostic evaluation of terminal reaching ability. We further propose 3DG-VLN, a vision-language waypoint prediction framework guided by dynamic 3D direction cues to enhance fine-grained visual grounding and spatial direction alignment for precise target reaching. Specifically, 3DG-VLN adaptively processes high-resolution front-view and downward-view observations to preserve fine-grained visual and geometric details for target grounding. It also updates the target-relative direction online during closed-loop navigation, allowing the agent to maintain spatial alignment with the target and reduce accumulated direction drift. To support this task, we construct a dedicated high-resolution benchmark which contains 2,717 trajectories with target-oriented high-level instructions, high-resolution front-view and downward-view egocentric observations, and continuous 3D waypoint annotations. Experiments show that 3DG-VLN outperforms competitive UAV-VLN baselines, achieving a 13.82\% improvement in success rate. Real-world trials further demonstrate the potential of 3DG-VLN for practical see-and-reach navigation. The source code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/xuefanfu/3DG-VLN.

摘要（中文）：无人机视觉语言导航（UAV-VLN）通常被建模为一种全局搜索与到达问题，其中远程目标发现与最终目标接近被联合优化与评估。这种建模方式使得空中具身智能体的关键能力难以评估，即当目标进入无人机视野后，其能否准确识别可见目标，并将视觉语言证据转化为精确的三维运动。为克服这一局限，我们提出UAV-VLN-FOV，一种目标可见的导航任务，该任务分离了"看见与到达"阶段，并能够对终端到达能力进行更具诊断性的评估。我们进一步提出3DG-VLN，一种由动态三维方向线索引导的视觉语言航点预测框架，以增强细粒度视觉定位与空间方向对齐能力，实现精确的目标到达。具体而言，3DG-VLN自适应处理高分辨率前视与下视观测，以保留用于目标定位的细粒度视觉与几何细节。同时，在闭环导航过程中在线更新目标相对方向，使智能体能够保持与目标的空间对齐，并减少累积的方向漂移。为支撑该任务，我们构建了一个专用高分辨率基准数据集，包含2717条轨迹、面向目标的高级指令、高分辨率前视与下视自我中心观测及连续三维航点标注。实验表明，3DG-VLN优于具有竞争力的UAV-VLN基线方法，在成功率上提升了13.82%。真实环境试验进一步展示了3DG-VLN在实际"看见与到达"导航任务中的潜力。源代码与基准数据集可访问https://github.com/xuefanfu/3DG-VLN获取。

Authors: Fanfu Xue, En Yu, Yantian Shen, Zhikun Hu, Hongjun Wang, Yang Yang, Xindi Wang, Jiande Sun

Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models WorldModel

Reward as an Agent DynDiff-GRPO embodied world models reward hacking rollout diversification

简要说明：提出了“奖励作为智能体”的奖励框架，结合DynDiff-GRPO实现多样化展开，通过在分布偏移下减轻奖励黑客问题，实现可扩展的强化学习用于具身世界模型。

TLDR: Proposes Reward as an Agent, an agentic reward framework coupled with DynDiff-GRPO for diversified rollouts, enabling scalable RL for embodied world models by mitigating reward hacking under distribution shifts.

Abstract: While RL has become a promising tool for refining world models, existing methods largely rely on conservative rollouts near the training distribution, limiting exploration, behavioral diversity, and richer dynamic discovery. In this work, we challenge this conservative paradigm. We argue that the core limitation is not exploration itself, but the lack of reliable verification strategies to support broader exploration. Without reliable verification, expanded exploration becomes highly susceptible to reward hacking, where policies exploit imperfect rewards without achieving genuine improvement. To evaluate this motivation, we instantiate our method in embodied world models, where physical plausibility, and task completion provide a rigorous testbed for scalable RL under complex dynamics. On the verification side, we introduce Reward as an Agent, an agentic reward framework that actively evaluates generated behaviors to provide robust reward signals and mitigate reward hacking under distribution shifts. On the exploration side, we introduce Dynamic-Aware Rollout Diversification through DynDiff-GRPO, which explicitly expands action-space exploration to diversify trajectories, broaden state-action coverage, and encourage richer embodied behaviors beyond conservative rollout regimes. By unifying Reward as an Agent with DynDiff-GRPO, we enable RL on a more reliable reward foundation with substantially diversified sampling, effectively mitigating reward hacking while yielding significant accuracy gains across multiple open-source world models, thereby demonstrating that broader exploration can scale successfully when grounded in robust verification.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 尽管强化学习已成为优化世界模型的重要工具，但现有方法大多依赖于训练分布附近的保守展开，限制了探索、行为多样性以及更丰富的动态发现。在本文中，我们挑战了这一保守范式。我们认为，核心限制并非探索本身，而是缺乏可靠验证策略以支撑更广泛的探索。缺乏可靠验证时，扩展探索极易引发奖励破解现象，即策略利用不完善的奖励而未能实现真正改进。为评估这一动机，我们在具身世界模型中实例化所提方法，其中物理合理性与任务完成为复杂动态下的可扩展强化学习提供了严格的试验平台。在验证方面，我们提出“奖励即智能体”（Reward as an Agent）这一智能体奖励框架，主动评估生成行为以提供稳健的奖励信号，并缓解分布偏移下的奖励破解问题。在探索方面，我们通过DynDiff-GRPO引入动态感知展开多样化，显式扩展动作空间探索以丰富轨迹多样性、扩大状态-动作覆盖范围，并鼓励超越保守展开体制的更具具身特性的行为。通过将“奖励即智能体”与DynDiff-GRPO相结合，我们使强化学习建立在更可靠的奖励基础之上，同时实现大幅多样化的采样，有效缓解了奖励破解问题，并在多个开源世界模型中取得显著的精度提升，从而证明：在稳健验证的基础上，更广泛的探索能够成功扩展。

Authors: Pu Li, Zhigang Lin, Qiang Wu, Yongxuan Lv, Fei Wang, Shan You

PhysDrift: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in Humanoid Co-Speech Motion Generation HumanoidEmbodied

embodiment gap co-speech motion generation humanoid robots embodiment-aware generation physical regularization

简要说明：PhysDrift 提出了一种面向人形机器人的具身感知共语动作生成框架，直接从语音预测可执行的关节轨迹，跳过了以人为中心的 SMPL-X 流程，从而保留了运动多样性与物理可行性。

TLDR: PhysDrift proposes an embodiment-aware co-speech motion generation framework for humanoid robots that directly predicts executable joint trajectories from speech, bypassing the human-centric SMPL-X pipeline to preserve motion diversity and physical feasibility.

Abstract: Humanoid robots require co-speech motions that are not only expressive and speech-aligned, but also physically executable under embodiment constraints. Existing co-speech generation pipelines are predominantly human-centric: motions are first generated in human-body representations such as SMPL-X and subsequently retargeted to humanoid robots. In this work, we identify a fundamental embodiment gap in this paradigm, where the mismatch between human motion manifolds and humanoid embodiment constraints disrupts embodiment consistency during motion transfer and physical execution. Through extensive analysis, we show that although retargeting can preserve coarse motion semantics, it significantly compresses motion diversity and weakens prosody-motion synchronization, limiting expressive humanoid behaviors. To address this problem, we first propose IK-EER, a prosody-preserving humanoid motion curation framework that jointly optimizes kinematic feasibility and speech-motion temporal alignment during retargeting. Building upon the curated robot-native motion dataset, we further introduce PhysDrift, an embodiment-aware co-speech motion generation framework that directly predicts executable humanoid joint trajectories from speech without relying on intermediate human-body representations. Unlike conventional human-centric pipelines, PhysDrift maintains embodiment consistency throughout both training and inference while incorporating physical regularization to stabilize robot motion dynamics. Extensive experiments and real-world humanoid deployment demonstrate that embodiment-aware robot-native generation substantially improves speech-motion alignment, physical plausibility, motion smoothness, inference efficiency, and real-time interaction capability.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人需要伴随语音的动作，这些动作不仅应富有表现力且与语音同步，还必须在具体形态约束下具备物理可执行性。现有伴随语音生成流程主要基于人类中心范式：首先在SMPL-X等人形表征中生成动作，随后将其重定向至人形机器人。本研究发现该范式存在根本性的形态差异问题——人类运动流形与人形机器人形态约束之间的不匹配，导致动作迁移和物理执行过程中形态一致性遭到破坏。通过深入分析，我们证明虽然重定向能保留粗粒度运动语义，但会显著压缩动作多样性并削弱韵律-运动同步性，限制人形机器人的表现力行为。针对该问题，我们首先提出IK-EER框架，这是一种保留韵律特征的人形运动整理框架，能在重定向过程中联合优化运动学可行性与语音-运动时序对齐。基于整理后的机器人原生运动数据集，我们进一步提出PhysDrift框架，这是一种形态感知的伴随语音运动生成框架，无需依赖中间人形表征即可直接从语音预测可执行的人形机器人关节轨迹。与传统人类中心流水线不同，PhysDrift在训练和推理全程保持形态一致性，同时引入物理正则化以稳定机器人运动动力学。大量实验及真实人形机器人部署证明，形态感知的机器人原生生成方法能显著提升语音-运动对齐度、物理合理性、运动平滑性、推理效率及实时交互能力。

Authors: Zhangzhao Liang, Xiaofen Xing, Mingyue Yang, Wenlve Zhou, Xiangmin Xu

FrozenDrive: Zero-Shot Text-Guided Driving Scene Generation and Data Augmentation with Parameter-Free Frozen Diffusion Model AutonomousDriving

zero-shot scene generation frozen diffusion model multi-view consistency temporal coherence autonomous driving data augmentation

简要说明：FrozenDrive 是一种无需参数调整的冻结扩散模型，用于可控文本引导驾驶场景生成，在无需微调的情况下实现多视图和时间一致性，并通过数据增强提升下游自动驾驶模型性能。

TLDR: FrozenDrive is a parameter-free frozen diffusion model for controllable text-guided driving scene generation that achieves multi-view and temporal consistency without fine-tuning, and improves downstream AD model performance via data augmentation.

Abstract: Synthetic data for autonomous driving is surging, powered by diffusion models that promise scalable scene generation. Yet key obstacles remain, as enforcing multi-view and temporal consistency often relies on backbone fine-tuning or added layers, which erodes pre-trained knowledge and weakens text alignment. Models also stay close to the training distribution, struggling under adverse weather and unseen configurations, and fidelity favors frequent over rare classes. We address these gaps with FrozenDrive, a controllable generative framework that preserves a pretrained diffusion models knowledge while achieving strong consistency. FrozenDrive conditions on rich driving-stack signals and text prompts, and introduces knowledge-preserving spatio-temporal attention to impose cross-view alignment and temporal coherence in a single pass within a parameter-free frozen diffusion backbone. An additional object-focused constraint improves per-object fidelity for rare categories. Without any weather- or scene-specific fine-tuning, our model synthesizes globally coherent multi-view driving scenes from text, particularly under adverse and rare conditions, and surpasses prior baselines. On nuScenes, FrozenDrive augmented data significantly improves AD models performance, especially at night and in rain, demonstrating stronger robustness when trained with our scenario-targeted data.

摘要（中文）：面向自动驾驶的合成数据正蓬勃发展，扩散模型为其提供了可扩展的场景生成能力。然而，关键障碍依然存在：强制实现多视图与时间一致性往往依赖于骨干网络微调或附加网络层，这会侵蚀预训练知识并削弱文本对齐能力。模型仍局限于训练数据分布，在恶劣天气与未见配置下表现欠佳，且保真度倾向于高频类别而非稀有类别。我们通过FrozenDrive框架填补这些空白——该可控生成框架在保持预训练扩散模型知识的同时实现了强一致性。FrozenDrive以丰富的驾驶堆栈信号与文本提示为条件，引入知识保留型时空注意力机制，在无参数冻结扩散骨干网络中通过单次前向传播施加跨视图对齐与时间连贯性。针对稀有类别的额外目标聚焦约束提升了每个物体的保真度。无需任何天气或场景特定微调，我们的模型即可从文本合成全局一致的多视图驾驶场景，尤其在恶劣与稀有条件下表现突出，并超越现有基线。在nuScenes数据集上，经FrozenDrive增强的数据显著提升了自动驾驶模型性能，尤其在夜间和雨天场景中——当使用我们面向场景的目标数据进行训练时，模型展现出更强的鲁棒性。

Authors: Yuhwan Jeong, Hyeonseong Kim, Daehyun We, Seonkyu Song, Jinnyeong Yang, Hyun-Kurl Jang, Youngho Yoon, Kuk-Jin Yoon

EventVLA: Event-Driven Visual Evidence Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

sparse visual evidence memory keyframe evidence memory long-horizon manipulation vision-language-action policy robotic memory

简要说明：EventVLA 通过前瞻性的关键帧选择机制构建稀疏视觉证据记忆，显著提升长期机器人操作任务的成功率，相比现有 VLA 模型平均提高 40%。

TLDR: EventVLA introduces a sparse visual evidence memory with foresight-driven keyframe selection to improve long-horizon robotic manipulation, achieving a +40% success rate over prior VLA models.

Abstract: Memory remains a critical bottleneck for long-horizon robotic manipulation, as standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often fail when task-relevant cues become occluded or unobservable over time. While existing memory-augmented methods utilize historical context, they either suffer from severe information bottlenecks, incur high latency via decoupled dual systems, or rely on unselective buffers that accumulate massive visual redundancies. To address these limitations, we introduce EventVLA, an end-to-end framework founded on the concept of sparse visual evidence memory that comprises two core components: foundational visual anchors to retain initial and short-term contexts, and a dynamic Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) module. Specifically, KEM directly predicts future keyframe probabilities from the VLA's latent embeddings to autonomously capture and store sparse, task-critical visual events. This foresight-driven mechanism empowers the policy to dynamically evaluate the future causal utility of current observations, preserving transient visual evidence before it becomes unobservable. Furthermore, we propose RoboTwin-MeM, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate non-Markovian manipulation tasks with interactive visual evidence. Extensive evaluations show that across 17 memory-requiring simulation tasks and 4 real-world bimanual tasks, EventVLA achieves an average success rate improvement of +40% over state-of-the-art memory-augmented VLAs.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在长时域机器人操作任务中，记忆仍是关键瓶颈——当任务相关的视觉线索随时间推移被遮挡或不可观测时，标准视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略往往失效。现有记忆增强方法虽能利用历史上下文，但存在以下问题：严重的信息瓶颈、解耦双系统导致的高延迟，或依赖无选择性缓存而积累大量视觉冗余。为克服这些局限，我们提出EventVLA，一种基于稀疏视觉证据记忆概念的端到端框架，包含两个核心组件：保留初始与短期上下文的根基性视觉锚点，以及动态关键帧证据记忆（KEM）模块。具体而言，KEM直接从VLA的潜在嵌入中预测未来关键帧概率，自主捕获并存储稀疏的、任务关键的视觉事件。这种前瞻驱动机制使策略能够动态评估当前观测的未来因果效用，在瞬态视觉证据变得不可观测前加以保留。此外，我们提出诊断性基准RoboTwin-MeM，专门设计用于评估需交互式视觉证据的非马尔可夫操作任务。广泛评估表明，在17项需记忆的仿真任务与4项真实双臂操作任务中，EventVLA较当前最先进的记忆增强VLA实现了平均成功率+40%的提升。

Authors: Ganlin Yang, Zhangzheng Tu, Yuqiang Yang, Sitong Mao, Junyi Dong, Tianxing Chen, Jiaqi Peng, Jing Xiong, Jiafei Cao, Jifeng Dai, Wengang Zhou, Yao Mu, Tai Wang

SurgVista: Long-Horizon Surgical World Modeling with Plausible Instrument-Tissue Dynamics WorldModel

surgical world model long-horizon prediction deformation consistency drift adaptation instrument-tissue dynamics

简要说明：SurgVista 提出了一种手术世界模型，通过变形一致性正则化和漂移自适应训练，在长程预测中实现空间与时间的一致性，在 SurgWorld-Bench 基准上超越现有方法。

TLDR: SurgVista introduces a surgical world model with Deformation Consistency Regularization and Drift Adaptation Training to produce spatially and temporally coherent long-horizon predictions, outperforming prior methods on the new SurgWorld-Bench benchmark.

Abstract: Scaling robot policy learning for autonomous surgery is challenging, as expert demonstrations are expensive and in vivo exploration poses substantial safety risks. Surgical world models address this by generating realistic, action-conditioned future frames from an initial observation, but existing methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: spatial interaction incoherence, where visible instrument contact fails to induce spatially consistent tissue deformation, and temporal fidelity collapse, where prediction errors compound across autoregressive rollouts and progressively corrupt visual quality. We present SurgVista, a surgical world model that mitigates both failures through two training recipes. Deformation Consistency Regularization extracts scene-point trajectories from training videos and enforces cross-frame coherence through latent contrastive learning, strengthening physically consistent instrument-tissue dynamics. Drift Adaptation Training mitigates long-horizon drift by perturbing conditioning frames with online prediction residuals and photometric augmentations calibrated to long-horizon drift statistics, sustaining visual fidelity over extended rollouts. To enable rigorous evaluation, we further introduce SurgWorld-Bench, featuring diverse procedure types, long-range rollouts, and decoupled metrics for instrument-motion accuracy and tissue-response fidelity. Extensive experiments show that SurgVista consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across visual quality, temporal consistency, and interaction fidelity, with gains widening as the prediction horizon grows.

摘要（中文）：将机器人策略学习扩展到自主手术领域极具挑战性，因为专家示范成本高昂，而体内探索存在重大安全风险。手术世界模型通过从初始观测生成逼真的、受动作约束的未来帧来解决这一问题，但现有方法存在两种持续的失败模式：空间交互不一致性（即可见器械接触未能引发空间一致的组织变形）和时间保真度崩溃（即预测误差会随自回归推演而累积，渐进式破坏视觉质量）。我们提出SurgVista——一种通过两种训练策略来缓解上述失败的手术世界模型。形变一致性正则化从训练视频中提取场景点轨迹，并通过潜在对比学习强制跨帧一致性，从而增强物理一致的器械-组织动力学。漂移自适应训练通过使用在线预测残差和根据长程漂移统计量校准的光度增强来扰动条件帧，从而缓解长时域漂移，在扩展推演中维持视觉保真度。为支持严格评估，我们进一步引入SurgWorld-Bench基准，其包含多样化手术类型、长程推演以及针对器械运动精度和组织响应保真度的解耦指标。大量实验表明，SurgVista在视觉质量、时间一致性和交互保真度上始终优于现有最先进方法，且随着推演步长增加性能优势进一步扩大。
