Authors: Wentao Pan, Wuyang Li, Shengyuan Liu, Xinyu Liu, Hengyu Liu, Yixuan Yuan

Mix-QVLA: Task-Evidence-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

mixed-precision quantization vision-language-action models task-evidence-aware post-training quantization OpenVLA

简要说明：Mix-QVLA 提出了一种任务证据感知的混合精度训练后量化框架，用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在保持任务性能的同时显著减少内存并加速推理。

TLDR: Mix-QVLA introduces a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision post-training quantization framework for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, achieving significant memory reduction and inference speedup while preserving task performance.

Abstract: We propose Mix-QVLA, a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ framework for VLA models. Mix-QVLA anchors each quantized variant to the full-precision action-token reference decision and evaluates whether quantization preserves task-relevant evidence across key VLA functional boundaries. It computes normalized gradient-weighted task-evidence maps from boundary activations and compares full-precision and quantized maps using evidence-mass and attribution-distribution distortion, capturing changes in both the strength and allocation of decision-supporting evidence. A soft-bottleneck objective aggregates boundary-level degradation into layer-wise sensitivity scores. Mix-QVLA further models sensitivity throughout task execution, capturing phase-dependent shifts in layer importance rather than assuming a fixed sensitivity profile. The resulting evidence- and time-aware scores guide mixed-precision bit allocation under model-size and BitOps budgets. Extensive evaluations on OpenVLA-style policies show that Mix-QVLA improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of low-bit VLA deployment. On LIBERO, Mix-QVLA reduces OpenVLA-OFT memory from 15.4 GB to 4.1 GB, retains 96.3 average success compared with 97.1 for the BF16 model, and achieves a 1.52x inference speedup.

摘要（中文）：我们提出Mix-QVLA，一种面向VLA模型的任务证据感知混合精度后训练量化框架。Mix-QVLA将每个量化变体锚定至全精度动作令牌参考决策，并评估量化能否在关键VLA功能边界上保留任务相关证据。它从边界激活中计算归一化梯度加权任务证据图，并通过证据质量与归因分布失真比较全精度与量化图，从而捕捉决策支持证据在强度与分配上的变化。一种软瓶颈目标将边界级退化聚合为层敏感度评分。Mix-QVLA进一步对任务执行过程中的敏感度进行建模，捕捉层重要性随阶段变化的动态特性，而非假设一个固定的敏感度分布。所得到的证据与时间感知评分在模型大小与BitOps预算约束下指导混合精度比特分配。基于OpenVLA风格策略的广泛评估表明，Mix-QVLA优化了低比特VLA部署的精度-效率权衡。在LIBERO上，Mix-QVLA将OpenVLA-OFT内存占用从15.4 GB降至4.1 GB，平均成功率保留96.3%（BF16模型为97.1%），并实现1.52倍推理加速。

Authors: Navin Ranjan, Andreas Savakis

Fast Human Attention Prediction for Fixation-guided Active Perception in Autonomous Navigation RLRobot

Liquid Neural Networks scanpath prediction active perception autonomous navigation reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出了GazeLNN，一种利用液态神经网络和MobileNetV3的轻量级扫描路径预测模型，并将其集成到基于强化学习的主动相机-机器人控制策略中，用于自主导航中的人类注视引导感知。

TLDR: This paper introduces GazeLNN, a lightweight scanpath prediction model using Liquid Neural Networks and MobileNetV3, which is integrated into an RL-based active camera-robot control policy for human-fixation-guided perception in autonomous navigation.

Abstract: Human visual attention relies on structured scanpaths to efficiently process scenes, yet instilling this behavior into robot autonomy is in its infancy and hindered by the high,computational costs of existing predictive models. To address this, we introduce GazeLNN, a computationally lightweight,scanpath prediction model that leverages Liquid Neural Networks as its recurrent engine and employs MobileNetV3 for feature extraction. Operating auto-regressively, the architecture predicts sequential fixation heatmaps conditioned on the current visual stimulus and fixation history. Despite requiring only 0.61 GFLOPs, GazeLNN achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MIT Low Resolution dataset achieving 0.47 ScanMatch score. It outperforms existing recurrent baselines across diverse evaluation metrics, while reducing computational costs by 99.40% and accelerating inference by up to six times. To investigate the role of human attention modeling in robot autonomy and demonstrate the practical utility of this highly efficient architecture, we integrate GazeLNN into an active camera-robot control policy trained via Reinforcement Learning. This integration enables human-fixation-guided perception during autonomous navigation, validated through successful real-world deployments on an aerial robot.

摘要（中文）：人类视觉注意依赖结构化扫描路径以高效处理场景，但将该行为引入机器人自主系统仍处于初期阶段，且现有预测模型的高计算成本阻碍了其发展。为此，我们提出GazeLNN——一种计算轻量级的扫描路径预测模型，该模型采用液态神经网络作为其循环引擎，并利用MobileNetV3进行特征提取。该架构以自回归方式运行，基于当前视觉刺激和注视历史预测顺序注视热图。尽管仅需0.61 GFLOPs的计算量，GazeLNN在MIT低分辨率数据集上仍取得了最先进的性能，ScanMatch得分达0.47。它在多项评估指标上均优于现有循环基线模型，同时将计算成本降低99.40%，并将推理速度提升高达六倍。为探究人类注意力建模在机器人自主系统中的作用，并展示该高效架构的实际应用价值，我们将GazeLNN集成至基于强化学习训练的主动相机-机器人控制策略中。该集成实现了自主导航过程中由人类注视引导的感知，并通过在无人机上的实际部署验证了其有效性。

Authors: Fatma Youssef Mohammed, Grzegorz Malczyk, Kostas Alexis

Belt-Finger: An Affordable Soft Belt-Driven Gripper for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Manipulation

soft gripper dexterous in-hand manipulation belt-driven mechanism MPC control teleoperation

简要说明：Belt-Finger 是一种软带驱动的手指模块，为标准平行爪夹持器增加了三个手内自由度（平移、俯仰和滚动），在保持简单、廉价且易于集成现有控制管道的同时实现灵巧操作。

TLDR: Belt-Finger is a soft belt-driven gripper module that adds three in-hand degrees of freedom (translation, pitch, roll) to standard parallel-jaw grippers, enabling dexterous manipulation while remaining simple, inexpensive, and easy to integrate with existing control pipelines.

Abstract: Parallel-jaw grippers are the default manipulator choice in robotics because they are simple, robust, and inexpensive. Their limited in-hand mobility, however, often forces large arm motions and restricts dexterous manipulation in confined workspaces. We present a parallel-gripper upgrade: a double-soft-belt-based finger module that preserves standard opening/closing while adding three in-hand degrees of freedom (DoF): translation, pitch, and roll. The mechanism is deliberately kept simple and engineered for inexpensive manufacturing and straightforward integration, preserving the reliability and precise control of traditional parallel grippers while greatly broadening the range of manipulation capabilities. To demonstrate the utility of the added DoFs, we integrate the gripper in two control pipelines. First, we adapt a model predictive controller for in-hand manipulation of known objects. Second, we introduce a lightweight teleoperation interface that enables simultaneous control of the robot arm and gripper (10 DoFs total) with minimal hardware. Across a suite of challenging manipulation tasks executed via teleoperation, MPC, and trained policies, the proposed gripper consistently improves dexterity and task feasibility compared to a conventional parallel gripper

摘要（中文）：平行夹爪是机器人技术中默认的操纵器选择，因其结构简单、坚固耐用且成本低廉。然而其有限的手内移动性常常迫使机械臂进行大幅运动，并在受限工作空间中限制灵巧操作。我们提出一种平行夹爪升级方案：基于双软带的手指模块，在保留标准开合功能的同时，增加了三个手内自由度（DoF）：平移、俯仰和滚动。该机构刻意保持简洁，并针对低成本制造和直接集成进行工程设计，在极大拓宽操作能力范围的同时，保留了传统平行夹爪的可靠性和精准控制特性。为验证新增自由度的实用性，我们将该夹爪集成到两条控制管线中。首先，我们针对已知物体的手内操作适配了模型预测控制器。其次，我们引入一个轻量级远程操作界面，能以最少硬件实现机械臂与夹爪的协同控制（总计10个自由度）。通过远程操作、MPC及训练策略执行的一系列具有挑战性的操作任务，与传统平行夹爪相比，所提出的夹爪显著提升了灵巧性与任务可行性。

Authors: Boya Zhang, Andreas Zell, Georg Martius

Co-policy: Responsive Human-Robot Co-Creation for Musical Performances Manipulation

human-robot co-creation visuomotor policy Gaussian-Mixture policy musical robots VLM planner

简要说明：Co-policy 是一个人机音乐共创框架，将语义理解、音乐变化与视觉运动执行分离，采用微调 VLM 规划器和高斯混合视动策略实现实时的物理化音乐表演。

TLDR: Co-policy is a framework for human-robot musical co-creation that separates semantic grounding, musical variation, and visuomotor execution, using a fine-tuned VLM planner and a Gaussian-Mixture Visuomotor Policy for real-time physically performed music.

Abstract: Art has long stood as a pivotal expression of human creativity. Embodied artificial intelligence offers a route for generative models to participate in that creativity through physical action rather than disembodied digital content. In robotic music co-creation, it is challenging to connect semantic musical understanding with real-time and physically executable performance. We present Co-policy, a framework for human-robot musical co-creation that separates semantic intent grounding, constrained musical variation, and visuomotor execution. To ground musical semantics, Co-policy uses pre-inference semantic anchors and a fine-tuned Qwen-vl planner (F-Qwen) to transform speech, live musical seeds, and visual observations into structured co-creation plans. To support low-latency execution, Co-policy introduces a Gaussian-Mixture Visuomotor Policy (GMP), implemented as a conditional mixture-density policy that maps target notes and visual context to multimodal robot actions in a single forward pass. Unlike robotic playback systems that merely reproduce user-specified notes, Co-policy generates complementary musical responses under both musical and physical constraints. Real-robot chime experiments, ablations, and expert evaluation show improved intent alignment, execution accuracy, and response frequency over diffusion-policy and ablated baselines, supporting physically grounded action generation as a key requirement for embodied human-AI co-creation.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 艺术长久以来一直是人类创造力的核心表达形式。具身人工智能为生成模型提供了一条路径，使其能够通过物理动作而非脱离实体的数字内容参与到这种创造力之中。在机器人音乐协同创作中，将语义层面的音乐理解与实时、可物理执行的演奏相连接是一项挑战。我们提出了Co-policy框架，这是一种人机音乐协同创作框架，它将语义意图锚定、受约束的音乐变奏及视觉运动执行分离开来。为了锚定音乐语义，Co-policy使用预推理语义锚点及微调后的Qwen-vl规划器（F-Qwen），将语音、实时音乐种子和视觉观测转化为结构化的协同创作计划。为了支持低延迟执行，Co-policy引入了高斯混合视觉运动策略（GMP），该策略实现为一种条件混合密度策略，可在单次前向传播中将目标音符与视觉上下文映射为多模态机器人动作。与仅仅复现用户指定音符的机器人回放系统不同，Co-policy在音乐和物理双重约束下生成互补性的音乐响应。真实机器人钟琴实验、消融研究及专家评估表明，与扩散策略及消融基线相比，该方法在意图对齐、执行准确性和响应频率方面均有提升，从而验证了基于物理的动作生成作为具身人机协同创作的关键需求。

Authors: Xuetao Li, Wenke Huang, Mang Ye, Zijian Liu, Jinhua Xie, Jifeng Xuan, Miao Li

One-to-Two Acting: A Novel Framework for Single-arm Agent Action Expansion to Dual Arms Manipulation

dual-arm manipulation action expansion single-arm supervision multimodal large language model hierarchical planning

简要说明：ExS2D 是一个层次化框架，仅利用单臂演示数据实现双臂操作，通过将任务分解为子任务、动作落地以及多模态大模型协调器进行无碰撞规划，在无需双臂训练数据的情况下将执行步骤减少 54.4%。

TLDR: ExS2D is a hierarchical framework that enables dual-arm manipulation using only single-arm demonstration data by decomposing tasks into subtasks, grounding actions, and using an MLLM coordinator for collision-free planning, achieving a 54.4% reduction in execution steps with no bimanual training data.

Abstract: Dual-arm manipulation can improve throughput via parallel execution, but collecting bimanual demonstrations for training is costly and difficult. We present ExS2D, a hierarchical action expansion framework that enables dual-arm manipulation from single-arm supervision. ExS2D first generates structured subtasks from textual instructions while explicitly capturing temporal precedence. It then grounds each subtask into executable actions through subtask-guided action mapping in observation. Finally, precedence-aware action allocation and synchronized planning are performed by a multimodal large language model driven coordinator to select collision-free dual-arm executions. Simulation experiments demonstrate that ExS2D reduces the average execution steps by 54.4% while maintaining a comparable success rate to a single-arm baseline. Real-robot experiments on four tasks further demonstrate the reliability of ExS2D for dual-arm execution under few-shot single-arm samples, while using zero bimanual demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：双臂操作可通过并行执行提高吞吐量，但收集用于训练的双臂演示数据成本高昂且难度较大。本文提出ExS2D层级化动作扩展框架，该框架利用单臂监督实现双臂操作。ExS2D首先根据文本指令生成结构化子任务，并显式捕获时间先后关系；随后通过观测中的子任务引导动作映射，将每个子任务落实到可执行动作；最后由多模态大语言模型驱动的协调器执行优先级感知的动作分配与同步规划，以选择无碰撞的双臂执行方案。仿真实验表明，ExS2D在保持与单臂基线相当成功率的同时，将平均执行步骤减少了54.4%。在四项任务上的真实机器人实验进一步验证了ExS2D在零双臂演示样本条件下，基于少样本单臂数据即可实现可靠双臂执行的可行性。

Authors: Youbin Yao, Nieqin Cao, Mingyan Li, Yan Ding, Fuqiang Gu, Chao Chen

TIDY: Thermal Infrared Image Denoising via Wavelet Domain Entropy and Directional Stripe Index Perception3D

thermal infrared denoising wavelet domain stripe artifact suppression robust perception indoor robotics

简要说明：TIDY 提出一种轻量级小波域热红外图像去噪方法，在真实数据上训练，显式分离噪声与内容，提升惯性里程计和深度估计等下游机器人任务。

TLDR: TIDY proposes a lightweight wavelet-domain denoiser for thermal infrared images, trained on real data, that explicitly separates noise from content and improves downstream robotics tasks like inertial odometry and depth estimation.

Abstract: Thermal infrared (TIR) imaging has been a popular choice for field robotics due to its robust perception capability under low light visual degradation, but it suffers from severe stochastic and fixed-pattern noise that breaks downstream estimation. This noise is intensified indoors due to low thermal contrast and uniform temperature distributions, contributing to the relative lack of indoor TIR deployments. Existing TIR denoising methods exhibit a poor accuracy-efficiency tradeoff, either too slow for online deployment required in robotics or insufficiently robust to severe degradation, while typically being trained on synthetic noise. Addressing these problems, we propose TIDY, a lightweight wavelet-domain denoiser trained on real clean-noisy TIR data. By reformulating TIR denoising in the wavelet domain, TIDY explicitly disentangles noise from structural content, enabling targeted suppression with reduced spatial complexity, significantly improving inference speed over prior methods (~34Hz). TIDY introduces two new metrics, Wavelet Entropy and Wavelet Directional Stripe Index, as complementary loss terms to explicitly suppress stochastic noise and stripe artifacts. Across severe indoor corruption and zero-shot settings, TIDY improves robustness and yields consistent gains in downstream robotics tasks including thermal inertial odometry and monocular depth estimation. Code and dataset is available at: https://github.com/williamrheeth/TIDY

摘要（中文）：热红外（TIR）成像因其在低光视觉退化环境下具有鲁棒感知能力，已成为野外机器人的常用选择，但其存在严重的随机噪声和固定图案噪声，影响后续估计。由于室内环境热对比度低且温度分布均匀，此类噪声会进一步加剧，导致热红外在室内部署相对不足。现有TIR去噪方法在精度与效率之间存在较差的权衡，要么速度过慢无法满足机器人所需的在线部署要求，要么对严重退化不够鲁棒，且通常基于合成噪声进行训练。针对这些问题，我们提出了TIDY——一种基于真实干净-含噪TIR数据训练的轻量级小波域去噪器。通过在小波域重新定义TIR去噪问题，TIDY将噪声与结构内容明确分离，实现了目标性抑制并降低了空间复杂度，同时显著提升了推理速度（约34Hz），优于先前方法。TIDY引入了两个新指标——小波熵和小波方向条纹指数，作为补充损失项以显式抑制随机噪声和条纹伪影。在严重的室内退化及零样本设定下，TIDY提升了鲁棒性，并在下游机器人任务（包括热惯性里程计和单目深度估计）中取得了持续性能提升。代码与数据集已开源：https://github.com/williamrheeth/TIDY

Authors: Tai Hyoung Rhee, Dong-Guw Lee, Ayoung Kim

Data Standards for Humanoid Robotics: The Missing Infrastructure for Physical AI HumanoidEmbodied

data standards humanoid robotics embodied interaction data physical coherence non-cumulative data

简要说明：本文认为数据标准是人形机器人基础设施的关键，提出ISO/WD 26264-1标准，使具身经验可解释、可共享、可追溯和可复用。

TLDR: This paper argues that data standards are essential infrastructure for humanoid robotics, proposing ISO/WD 26264-1 to make embodied experience interpretable, shareable, traceable, and reusable.

Abstract: The scalability of humanoid robots will depend not only on models and hardware, but also on whether physical experience can accumulate across robots, tasks, organizations, and time. Drawing on the authors' work in developing ISO/WD 26264-1, Humanoid robot datasets -- Part 1: General requirements, within ISO/TC 299/WG 16, this article argues that data standards are becoming foundational infrastructure for Physical AI. We develop three insights. First, humanoid robot data is embodied interaction data, not a collection of isolated digital samples; a useful dataset must preserve the relationship among robot body, action, task, scene, execution trace, and outcome. Second, its value depends on physical coherence: multimodal streams are reusable only when timing, coordinate frames, calibration, kinematics, units, and synchronization assumptions remain inspectable. Third, the main bottleneck is not only data scarcity, but non-cumulative data caused by high collection costs, data silos, and inconsistent evaluation. We argue that humanoid robot data standards address these bottlenecks by making embodied experience interpretable, shareable, traceable, and reusable. A general standard should provide horizontal infrastructure for lifecycle management, metadata, provenance, quality, versioning, and traceability, while capability-specific parts should define domain grammar for manipulation, locomotion, human-robot interaction, cognition, and future humanoid capabilities. As AI moves from screens into bodies, data standards must evolve from organizing digital information to structuring physical interaction.

摘要（中文）：人类机器人的可扩展性不仅取决于模型与硬件，更取决于物理经验能否跨机器人、任务、组织及时间维度实现累积。本文基于作者在ISO/TC 299/WG 16工作组中参与制定ISO/WD 26264-1《人形机器人数据集 第1部分：通用要求》的工作，论证数据标准正成为物理人工智能的基础设施。我们提出三项核心见解：第一，人形机器人数据是具身交互数据，而非孤立数字样本的集合；有效数据集必须保留机器人本体、动作、任务、场景、执行轨迹与结果之间的关联。第二，其价值取决于物理一致性：只有当时间、坐标系、标定参数、运动学模型、度量单位及同步假设可被审计时，多模态数据流才具备可复用性。第三，主要瓶颈不仅在于数据匮乏，更在于高采集成本、数据孤岛与评估不一致导致的非累积性数据。我们认为，人形机器人数据标准通过使具身经验可解释、可共享、可追溯与可复用来突破上述瓶颈。通用标准应为生命周期管理、元数据、数据溯源、质量管控、版本控制和可追溯性提供横向基础设施，而能力专用模块则应定义操作、移动、人机交互、认知及未来人形机器人能力的领域语法。随着人工智能从屏幕走向实体，数据标准必须从组织数字信息演进为构建物理交互结构。

Authors: Shaoshan Liu, Xiugong Qin, Xuan Wu, Xuan Xia, Ning Ding, Jialu Liu, Jie Tang

Temporal Self-Imitation Learning RLRobot

temporal self-imitation efficiency-weighted imitation long-horizon manipulation reinforcement learning self-supervision

简要说明：TSIL从强化学习训练中挖掘时间高效的成功轨迹，并将其作为自监督信号，提升长时域机器人操作任务的学习效率和鲁棒性。

TLDR: TSIL mines temporally efficient successful trajectories from RL training and uses them as self-supervision to improve long-horizon robot manipulation learning efficiency and robustness.

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation policies trained with reward shaping can still exploit dense rewards through inefficient interaction, while rare efficient behaviors may be forgotten during training. We argue that temporal efficiency itself provides a powerful and underutilized source of self-supervision for reinforcement learning. We introduce Temporal Self-Imitation Learning (TSIL), a reinforcement learning framework that mines temporally efficient successful trajectories generated during learning and converts them into reusable supervision for future policy improvement. TSIL progressively refines learning using configuration-conditioned adaptive temporal targets derived from fast successful trajectories, while preserving and replaying efficient behaviors through efficiency-weighted self-imitation learning. Across 15 distinct long-horizon manipulation tasks, TSIL consistently improves learning efficiency, task-completion efficiency, revisitation of fast successful behaviors, and robustness to unstable training conditions. More broadly, our results suggest that the temporal structure of successful behavior itself provides a scalable self-supervisory signal for reinforcement learning beyond manually engineered reward shaping alone.

摘要（中文）：基于奖励塑形训练的长时域机器人操作策略，仍可能通过低效交互利用密集奖励，而训练过程中罕见的高效行为则可能被遗忘。我们认为时间效率本身为强化学习提供了强大但未被充分利用的自监督来源。本文提出时间自模仿学习（TSIL）——一种从学习过程中挖掘时间高效的成功轨迹，并将其转化为可复用的监督信号以改进未来策略的强化学习框架。TSIL基于快速成功轨迹生成条件自适应时间目标，逐步优化学习过程，同时通过效率加权自模仿学习保留并回放高效行为。在15项不同的长时域操作任务中，TSIL持续提升了学习效率、任务完成效率、对快速成功行为的重访能力以及面对不稳定训练条件的鲁棒性。更广泛而言，我们的结果表明：成功行为本身的时间结构能够为强化学习提供超越人工奖励塑形之外的可扩展自监督信号。

Authors: Yinsen Jia, Boyuan Chen

Comparative Study on Agility, Efficiency, and Impact Absorption of Bipedal Robots with Active Toes Locomotion

bipedal robot active toes simulation training environment cost of transport agility

简要说明：本文提出了一种带有主动脚趾的14自由度双足机器人，并利用高保真仿真与强化学习训练，定量比较了其与无脚趾配置在敏捷性、效率和冲击吸收方面的表现，显示出运输成本和脚跟冲击地面反作用力的降低。

TLDR: This paper proposes a 14-DOF biped robot with active toes and uses a high-fidelity simulation with RL training to quantitatively compare agility, efficiency, and impact absorption against a toe-less configuration, showing reductions in cost of transport and heel-strike ground reaction force.

Abstract: Human legs exhibit high efficiency, agility, and impact absorption, with toes playing a crucial role in these capabilities. While many attempts have been made to implement human-like toes in robots, they have not fully replicated human characteristics nor rigorously validated their benefits. We propose a 14-DOF biped robot emulating human toes' lightweight, high-torque, robust nature. To quantitatively analyze the effectiveness of the active toes in terms of agility, efficiency, and impact absorption, we developed a high-fidelity simulation training environment that reflects actual actuators with coupled transmissions and accurate power consumption. To ensure a fair comparison between configurations with and without active toes, we designed a minimal RL reward function and applied an identical training procedure to both. The simulation results indicate that, at 1.33 m/s walking, the toe-equipped robot reduced CoT by 17.5% and heel-strike GRF by 5.0% compared with the toe-ablation configuration. On the agility test, average and maximum path deviation decreased by 25.0% and 34.0%, respectively.

摘要（中文）：人类腿部展现出高效性、敏捷性和冲击吸收能力，而脚趾在这些能力中发挥着关键作用。尽管已有许多尝试在机器人中实现类人脚趾，但尚未能完全复现人类特性，也未对其优势进行严格验证。我们提出了一种14自由度的双足机器人，模拟人类脚趾的轻量化、高扭矩和鲁棒特性。为定量分析主动脚趾在敏捷性、效率和冲击吸收方面的效果，我们开发了一个高保真仿真训练环境，该环境能够反映带有耦合传动装置的实际执行器及精确功耗。为确保在有无主动脚趾的构型之间进行公平比较，我们设计了最小化强化学习奖励函数，并对两种构型应用了相同的训练流程。仿真结果表明，在1.33米/秒行走速度下，与切除脚趾的构型相比，配备脚趾的机器人将运输成本降低了17.5%，并将足跟冲击地面反作用力降低了5.0%。在敏捷性测试中，平均路径偏差和最大路径偏差分别降低了25.0%和34.0%。

Authors: Joong-Gil Kim, Wontae Ye, Geunwoo Cho, Seong-Ho Yun, Se-Hyoung Cho, Yong-Jae Kim

ForEnt: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Characterizing Quadruped Robot Entrapments in Forest Environments Locomotion

quadruped robot forest entrapment multi-modal dataset terrains failures detection legged robot deployment

简要说明：ForEnt 是一个多模态数据集，记录四足机器人在森林环境中被缠住的事件，包含 RGB-D、LiDAR、本体感知和视频数据，用于辅助缠绕检测及提升机器人部署的鲁棒性。

TLDR: ForEnt is a multi-modal dataset capturing quadruped robot entrapment events in forest environments, including RGB-D, LiDAR, proprioceptive, and video data to facilitate entrapment detection and robust deployment.

Abstract: Legged robots are increasingly deployed in forests for ecological surveying and monitoring, yet their autonomy is often interrupted consequent to the challenges posed in traversing forest environments. Forest entrapments, for example, when a robot's legs are ensnared in vines or other vegetation, result in loss of stability and toppling. Such events not only disrupt the mission and require manual intervention, but also risk damage to the robot hardware. To address the absence of a dedicated dataset to investigate these failure modes in forest environments, we present ForEnt, a multi-modal dataset collected with the low-cost Unitree Go2 quadruped across eight forest sites in the Southampton Common Woodlands, UK. For our dataset, over approximately 1.7 km of traversals in 11 sequences were conducted, yielding 69 recorded entrapment events. ForEnt includes time-synchronized RGB-D images, LiDAR scans, proprioceptive data, and third-person video, enabling analysis of terrain factors contributing to entrapment and providing labeled sensor streams for reproducible benchmarking. By supporting the evaluation of entrapment detection strategies, ForEnt lowers the barrier to developing robust quadruped robot deployments in challenging forest environments.

摘要（中文）：足式机器人正越来越多地被部署于森林中进行生态调查与监测，然而其自主性常因穿越森林环境时所面临的挑战而中断。例如，当机器人腿部被藤蔓或其他植被缠住时，会导致森林陷阱问题，使其失去稳定性并翻倒。此类事件不仅中断任务执行、需要人工干预，还可能对机器人硬件造成损坏。针对缺乏专门数据集来研究森林环境中这些失效模式的问题，我们提出了ForEnt——一个利用低成本Unitree Go2四足机器人在英国南安普顿公地林地八个森林站点采集的多模态数据集。在该数据集中，我们通过11个序列完成了约1.7公里的穿越行程，记录了69次陷阱事件。ForEnt包含时间同步的RGB-D图像、激光雷达扫描、本体感知数据及第三人称视角视频，可分析导致陷阱的地形因素，并为可重复的基准测试提供带标注的传感器数据流。通过支持陷阱检测策略的评估，ForEnt降低了在复杂森林环境中开发鲁棒四足机器人部署方案的门槛。

Authors: Natapat Kirdwichai, Danesh Tarapore

DF-ExpEnse: Diffusion Filtered Exploration for Sample Efficient Finetuning Manipulation

exploration finetuning generative control policy sample efficiency ensemble critics

简要说明：DF-ExpEnse 是一种利用预训练生成控制策略和集成评论家来提高机器人操作和 locomotion 任务微调样本效率的探索技术。

TLDR: DF-ExpEnse is an exploration technique that leverages pretrained generative control policies and ensemble critics to improve the sample efficiency of finetuning in robotic manipulation and locomotion tasks.

Abstract: A natural recipe for intelligent robotic decision-making is initializing from pretrained generative control policies, which have summarized offline experience, and adapting them to self-collected online experience. We present DF-ExpEnse, an exploration technique that improves the quality of online experience collection, thus increasing finetuning sample-efficiency. DF-ExpEnse leverages the multimodal modeling capabilities of the generative control policy to create an expressive and tractably evaluatable candidate set. It then utilizes an ensemble of critics to identify the action that best balances quality with high exploration interest. In fleet settings, DF-ExpEnse further enables cross-agent communication to facilitate collaborative exploration as a group. DF-ExpEnse can be seamlessly integrated with existing strategies that finetune pretrained generative control policies via reinforcement learning. We experimentally validate consistent sample-efficiency benefits through DF-ExpEnse across a variety of manipulation and locomotion tasks, compared to default finetuning and alternative action selection schemes. Project can be found at https://df-expense.github.io.

摘要（中文）：一种实现智能机器人决策的自然策略是：从预训练的生成式控制策略（该策略已总结离线经验）初始化，并使其适应于自主收集的在线经验。我们提出DF-ExpEnse，一种能够提升在线经验收集质量的探索技术，从而增强微调样本效率。DF-ExpEnse利用生成式控制策略的多模态建模能力，构建一个具有表现力且易于评估的候选动作集，并借助集成评判器识别出在质量与高探索兴趣之间实现最佳平衡的动作。在集群场景下，DF-ExpEnse进一步支持跨智能体通信，以促进群体协同探索。DF-ExpEnse可无缝集成至通过强化学习微调预训练生成式控制策略的现有方案中。实验表明，在多种操作与运动任务中，相较于默认微调及替代动作选择方案，DF-ExpEnse始终带来样本效率提升。项目详情请见 https://df-expense.github.io。

Authors: Calvin Luo, Chen Sun, Shuran Song

Formal Verification of Learned Multi-Agent Communication Policies via Decision Tree Distillation RLRobot

multi-agent reinforcement learning formal verification decision tree distillation safety verification emergent communication

简要说明：一个通过决策树蒸馏对学习到的多智能体通信策略进行安全验证的框架，应用于多无人机协调和自动驾驶车队。

TLDR: A framework for safety verification of learned multi-agent communication policies via decision tree distillation, applied to multi-drone coordination and autonomous vehicle fleets.

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables agents to develop coordination strategies through emergent communication, but neural policies lack the formal safety guarantees required for safety-critical robotic deployment in drone swarms and autonomous vehicle fleets. We present the first end-to-end framework for safety verification of learned multi-agent communication policies through policy abstraction: neural policies are distilled into interpretable decision trees, then formally verified, with empirical validation confirming that verified safety properties transfer to original networks. Our four-stage pipeline consists of domain-specific feature extraction from agent observations, decision tree distillation achieving 97.9% +/- 1.2% fidelity to neural policies, automated translation to PRISM probabilistic model checker specifications with complete feature-to-state-variable correspondence, and compositional verification of Probabilistic Computation Tree Logic (PCTL) properties via pairwise decomposition with union-bound aggregation and empirical neighbor modeling. Evaluating Vector-Quantized Variational Information Bottleneck (VQ-VIB) policies for multi-drone coordination with 5-7 agents, we verify 18 temporal logic properties across safety, liveness, and cooperation, achieving 88.9% property satisfaction with all five safety thresholds satisfied (0.3% collision probability vs. 1% threshold). Monte Carlo validation of original neural policies confirms that verified safety properties transfer with <=0.6 percentage-point deviation (95% CI). Discrete VQ-VIB messages provide +11.6 to +13.6 percentage-point fidelity advantages over continuous methods, enabling 3-4x faster verification. Our framework provides empirically validated safety verification for distilled policy abstractions, serving as a practical bridge between deep MARL and formal safety workflows for multi-robot deployment.

摘要（中文）：多智能体强化学习（MARL）使智能体能够通过涌现通信发展协调策略，但神经策略缺乏无人机集群和自动驾驶车队等安全关键型机器人部署所需的正式安全保证。我们提出首个通过策略抽象实现学习型多智能体通信策略安全验证的端到端框架：将神经策略蒸馏为可解释决策树，进行形式化验证，并通过实证验证确认已验证的安全属性可迁移至原始网络。我们的四阶段流程包括：从智能体观测中提取领域特定特征、实现与神经策略97.9%±1.2%保真度的决策树蒸馏、自动转换为具备完整特征-状态变量对应关系的PRISM概率模型检测器规范，以及通过基于并集边界的成对分解与经验邻居建模对概率计算树逻辑（PCTL）属性进行组合验证。针对5-7个智能体的多无人机协调场景，对向量量化变分信息瓶颈（VQ-VIB）策略进行验证，我们验证了涵盖安全性、活性和协作性的18个时序逻辑属性，实现了88.9%的属性满足率，所有五项安全阈值均达标（碰撞概率0.3%，阈值1%）。原始神经策略的蒙特卡洛验证确认已验证安全属性的迁移偏差不超过0.6个百分点（95%置信区间）。离散VQ-VIB消息相比连续方法提供+11.6至+13.6个百分点的保真度优势，可实现3-4倍的验证加速。本框架为蒸馏策略抽象提供了经实证验证的安全验证，成为深度MARL与多机器人部署正式安全工作流之间的实用桥梁。

Authors: Ahmad Farooq, Kamran Iqbal

Fail-RAG : A Retrieval Augmented Generation Informed Framework for Robot Failure Identification Manipulation

Retrieval Augmented Generation failure detection Vision-Language Models warehouse automation robot arm

简要说明：提出了Fail-RAG，一种基于检索增强生成的框架，利用视觉语言模型和故障数据库检测仓库自动化中的机器人操作故障，比直接使用现成VLM的准确率更高。

TLDR: Proposes Fail-RAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses VLMs and a failure database to detect robot operation failures in warehouse automation, achieving higher accuracy than off-the-shelf VLMs.

Abstract: Industry automation is witnessing an evolution in robotics driven by both technological breakthroughs and societal changes: progress towards generalist robots, embodied and physical artificial intelligence (AI), and increasing labor shortage in manufacturing.An intelligent autonomous robot needs to not only act according to planned motions but also react to any unexpected events. In this study, we focus on such unexpected events in warehouses where robots are used for material handling. Specifically, we refer to any unexpected events as failures and develop methods to detect robot operations related failures. Rule-based detection methods may break since the form of failures could change due to the dynamic nature of both environments and tasks. We propose 'Fail-RAG', a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)-based failure detection framework where failure images and context information are embedded and queried against a failure database by calculating their similarities. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are further used to analyze failures and provide details by following our instruction template. We evaluated the performance of Fail-RAG by conducting both simulation and physical experiments using fixed robot arms and a mobile manipulator for multiple tasks that are common in warehouse automation. Fail-RAG achieved 25 percentage point higher failure detection accuracy on average across five types of robot operations compared to using off-the-shelf VLMs, indicating its effectiveness for real-world failure detection.

摘要（中文）：工业自动化领域正经历着由技术突破与社会变革共同驱动的机器人技术演进：通用型机器人、具身物理人工智能的发展，以及制造业日益严重的劳动力短缺。智能自主机器人不仅需要按照预定动作执行任务，还需对任何意外事件做出响应。本研究聚焦于机器人用于物料搬运的仓库场景中的此类意外事件。具体而言，我们将所有意外事件统称为故障，并开发了检测机器人操作相关故障的方法。由于环境与任务的动态特性可能导致故障形式变化，基于规则的检测方法可能失效。为此，我们提出Fail-RAG——一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的故障检测框架：通过计算相似度，将故障图像与环境信息嵌入并查询故障数据库。进一步利用视觉语言模型（VLM）遵循我们的指令模板对故障进行分析并提供细节。我们使用固定机械臂和移动操作平台，针对仓库自动化中常见的多项任务进行了仿真与物理实验，以评估Fail-RAG的性能。相较于直接使用现成VLM，Fail-RAG在五种机器人操作类型上的平均故障检测准确率提升了25个百分点，证明了其在实际场景故障检测中的有效性。

Authors: Ameya Salvi, Jie Hu

One Demo is Worth a Thousand Trajectories: Action-View Augmentation for Visuomotor Policies Manipulation

data augmentation Gaussian Splatting fisheye camera trajectory optimization visuomotor policy

简要说明：本文提出一种数据增强框架，通过对鱼眼相机的高斯溅射适配和轨迹优化，从单个真实演示生成视觉逼真的图像序列和物理可行的动作轨迹，从而提升视觉运动策略在操作任务中的成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a data augmentation framework that uses Gaussian Splatting adapted to fisheye cameras and trajectory optimization to generate visually realistic image sequences and physically feasible action trajectories from a single real-world demonstration, improving visuomotor policy success rates in manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies for manipulation have demonstrated remarkable potential in modeling complex robotic behaviors, yet minor alterations in the robot's initial configuration and unseen obstacles easily lead to out-of-distribution observations. Without extensive data collection effort, these result in catastrophic execution failures. In this work, we introduce an effective data augmentation framework that generates visually realistic fisheye image sequences and corresponding physically feasible action trajectories from real-world eye-in-hand demonstrations, captured with a portable parallel gripper with a single fisheye camera. We introduce a novel Gaussian Splatting formulation, adapted to wide FoV fisheye cameras, to reconstruct and edit the 3D scene with unseen objects. We utilize trajectory optimization to generate smooth, collision-free, view-rendering-friendly action trajectories and render visual observations from corresponding novel views. Comprehensive experiments in simulation and the real world show that our augmentation framework improves the success rate for various manipulation tasks in both the same scene and the augmented scene with obstacles requiring collision avoidance.

摘要（中文）：用于操控的视觉运动策略在建模复杂机器人行为方面展现出显著潜力，然而机器人初始构型的微小变化以及未观测到的障碍物容易导致观测数据分布外移。若缺乏大规模数据采集工作，这将引发灾难性的执行失败。在本研究中，我们提出了一种高效的数据增强框架，能够从真实世界中配备单鱼眼摄像头的便携式平行夹爪所采集的眼在手上演示数据中，生成视觉真实的鱼眼图像序列及相应物理可行的动作轨迹。我们提出了一种针对大视场鱼眼相机的新型高斯泼溅方法，用于重建和编辑包含未观测物体的三维场景。利用轨迹优化生成平滑、无碰撞且利于视角渲染的动作轨迹，并通过相应新颖视角渲染视觉观测结果。在仿真和真实环境中的综合实验表明，我们的增强框架在相同场景及需避障的障碍物增强场景中，均能提升多种操控任务的成功率。

Authors: Chuer Pan, Litian Liang, Dominik Bauer, Eric Cousineau, Benjamin Burchfiel, Siyuan Feng, Shuran Song

pdSTL: Probabilistic Differentiable Signal Temporal Logic for Stochastic Systems RLRobot

differentiable STL probabilistic semantics trajectory optimization belief-space uncertainty autonomous robots

简要说明：本文提出了pdSTL，一种概率化且可微分的信号时序逻辑框架，通过对信念轨迹计算保守满足界限，为随机机器人系统提供形式化安全保证，并在真实四旋翼飞行实验中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces pdSTL, a probabilistic and differentiable Signal Temporal Logic framework that provides formal safety guarantees for stochastic robotic systems by computing conservative satisfaction bounds over belief trajectories, and demonstrates its effectiveness in real-world quadcopter flight experiments.

Abstract: Autonomous robots operating in uncertain environments must satisfy complex temporal and safety specifications despite stochastic dynamics and sensing noise. While Signal Temporal Logic (STL) offers robustness measures for gradient-based optimization, existing extensions either lack differentiability or ignore belief-space uncertainty. We introduce pdSTL (probabilistic differentiable Signal Temporal Logic), a framework that unifies probabilistic semantics with differentiable robustness over belief trajectories. pdSTL employs interval-valued probabilistic semantics to compute conservative satisfaction bounds, propagated compositionally through the STL syntax tree. We formulate the temporal robustness evaluation as a recurrent, LSTM-style unfolding of STL operators, enabling linear-time, differentiable monitoring suitable for end-to-end trajectory optimization. We validate pdSTL on simulated obstacle avoidance, lane-change maneuvers, and real-world Crazyflie quadcopter flight experiments under aerodynamic disturbances. Results demonstrate that pdSTL achieves efficient optimization with formal probabilistic guarantees, significantly outperforming deterministic differentiable STL in maintaining safety margins under real-world uncertainty.

摘要（中文）：自主机器人在不确定环境中运行时，必须满足复杂的时间逻辑与安全规范，尽管存在随机动力学与感知噪声。尽管信号时态逻辑(STL)为基于梯度的优化提供了鲁棒性度量，但现有扩展要么缺乏可微性，要么忽略了置信空间的不确定性。我们提出pdSTL(概率可微信号时态逻辑)，这是一个统一概率语义与置信轨迹上可微鲁棒性的框架。pdSTL采用区间值概率语义计算保守满足界限，并通过STL语法树组合式传播。我们将时间鲁棒性评估构建为STL算子的循环LSTM式展开，从而实现适用于端到端轨迹优化的线性时间可微分监控。我们在模拟避障、换道机动以及气动干扰下的真实Crazyflie四旋翼飞行实验中验证了pdSTL。结果表明，pdSTL在提供形式化概率保证的同时实现高效优化，在真实不确定性下显著优于确定性可微STL在安全裕度保持方面的表现。

Authors: Bennett Dogbey, Hemanth Manjunatha

SCAN-Planner: Spatial Collision-Aware Local Planning for Route-Guided Long-Range Quadruped Navigation Locomotion

quadruped navigation local planning collision avoidance 3D occupancy map yaw-aware footprint

简要说明：SCAN-Planner 提出了一种空间碰撞感知的局部规划框架，用于四足机器人导航，通过偏航感知双圆柱足迹和投影A*搜索实现狭窄杂乱3D环境中的安全全身运动。

TLDR: SCAN-Planner proposes a spatial collision-aware local planning framework for quadruped navigation, using a yaw-aware twin-cylinder footprint and projected A* search to enable safe whole-body motion through narrow and cluttered 3D environments.

Abstract: Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to navigate through narrow passages, cluttered indoor scenes, and large-scale 3D unstructured environments. Existing local planners commonly approximate the robot using isotropic geometric inflation or rely on planar and elevation-map representations, leading to conservative motion in tight spaces and limited reasoning about overhanging structures. This letter presents SCAN-Planner, a spatial collision-aware local planning framework for long-range quadruped navigation. A yaw-aware twin-cylinder footprint is used to model the elongated robot body, enabling whole-body collision evaluation through sparse queries in an inflated 3D occupancy map. We further introduce a projected A* search that generates collision-free guidance on an interpolated ground-following surface, with z-gradient suppression to avoid obstacles horizontally while maintaining vertical stability. For large-scale deployment, a robot-centric sliding map with boundary fallback provides high-resolution local collision checking and recovery from local dead ends. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that SCAN-Planner generates safe, smooth, and efficient trajectories in dense clutter, 3D unstructured scenes, stair traversal, and long-range navigation tasks.

摘要（中文）：四足机器人越来越需要能够在狭窄通道、杂乱室内场景以及大规模三维非结构化环境中导航。现有局部规划器通常采用各向同性几何膨胀来近似机器人，或依赖平面与高程地图表示，这导致在狭小空间中运动过于保守，且对悬垂结构的推理能力有限。本文提出SCAN-Planner——一种面向长距离四足导航的空间碰撞感知局部规划框架。采用偏航感知双圆柱足迹对细长机器人本体进行建模，通过膨胀三维占据地图中的稀疏查询实现全身碰撞评估。我们进一步引入投影A*搜索算法，在插值生成的地面跟随曲面上生成无碰撞引导路径，并通过z梯度抑制在保持垂直稳定性的同时实现水平避障。针对大规模部署，采用带有边界回退机制的机器人中心滑动地图，提供高分辨率局部碰撞检测与局部死胡同恢复能力。仿真与真实世界实验表明，SCAN-Planner能在密集杂乱环境、三维非结构化场景、楼梯穿越等任务中生成安全、平滑且高效的轨迹。

Authors: Han Zheng, Zhe Chen, Yiwen Fu, Ming Yang, Tong Qin

Simulating Robotic Locomotion in Sand: Resistive Force Theory in an Open-Source Physics Engine Locomotion

Resistive Force Theory granular media hexapod robot MuJoCo locomotion simulation

简要说明：本文将3D颗粒阻力理论集成到MuJoCo物理引擎中，用于模拟机器人在沙地上的运动，预测结果与真实实验相差在20%以内。

TLDR: This paper integrates 3D Granular Resistive Force Theory into the MuJoCo physics engine to simulate robotic locomotion on sand, achieving predictions within 20% of real experiments.

Abstract: Recent advancements in Resistive Force Theory (RFT) enable approximation of ground reaction forces for locomotion in sand without the computational expense of modeling interactions with individual grains. However, these tools have been absent in 3D physics engines commonly used for robot simulation. We explore if resistive force approximations are sufficient, when integrated with standard dynamics calculations, to provide a stable substrate for a freely walking robot. To determine this, we implement 3D Granular Resistive Force Theory (3D RFT) in a physics simulation engine, MuJoCo. We verify simulations in multiple scenarios to demonstrate that key trends due to end effector shape, speed, and loading are preserved. Our implementation predicts walking distance and foot sinkage of a 12-Degree of Freedom hexapod robot within 20\% of experiments in sand. While RFT has inherent approximations, the open source tool described here has potential to help develop new and improved robot designs to traverse granular media substrates.

摘要（中文）：最近在阻力理论（RFT）方面的进展，使得在沙地环境中估算运动时的地面反作用力成为可能，而无需耗费计算资源对单个颗粒的相互作用进行建模。然而，这些工具在常用于机器人仿真的三维物理引擎中尚属空白。本文探究了将阻力近似方法与标准动力学计算相结合，是否为自由行走机器人提供稳定的支撑基底。为此，我们在物理仿真引擎MuJoCo中实现了三维颗粒阻力理论（3D RFT），并在多种场景下验证了仿真结果，证明由末端执行器形状、运动速度和载荷引起的关键趋势得以保留。我们的实现方法能够预测一台12自由度六足机器人在沙地中的行走距离与足部下陷深度，误差控制在实验实测值的20%以内。尽管RFT本身存在固有近似，本文所述的开源工具有望助力开发穿越颗粒介质基底的新型及改进型机器人设计。

Authors: Ryan Walker Brown, Laura K. Treers, Kathryn A. Daltorio

3D-DLP: Self-Supervised 3D Object-Centric Scene Representation Learning Manipulation

self-supervised object-centric 3D latent particles disentangled representation robotic manipulation

简要说明：一种自监督的3D物体中心表示学习方法，将RGB-D/体素输入分解为具有解耦3D属性的隐式粒子，并在下游机器人操作任务上取得了性能提升。

TLDR: A self-supervised 3D object-centric representation learning method that decomposes RGB-D/voxel inputs into latent particles with disentangled 3D attributes, and shows improved downstream robotic manipulation performance.

Abstract: We introduce 3D-DLP, a self-supervised object-centric representation learning model that decomposes scene-level RGB-D or voxel observations into a set of 3D latent particles. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, each particle encodes disentangled attributes, including 3D keypoint position, bounding box dimensions, and appearance features, and represents a distinct entity in the scene. The model learns interpretable per-particle segmentation maps through an end-to-end self-supervised reconstruction objective. We demonstrate on both simulated and real-world datasets that the learned latent space is interpretable and controllable: by manipulating particle positions and decoding, we can generate novel scene configurations. Furthermore, we show that leveraging these compact 3D latent particles for downstream robotic manipulation improves performance over baselines that either lack explicit 3D information or rely on memory-intensive dense 3D inputs without object-centric structure. Code and videos are available at https://eubooks3003.github.io/3d-dlp.

摘要（中文）：我们提出3D-DLP——一种自监督的以对象为中心的表示学习模型，它将场景级别的RGB-D或体素观测分解为一组3D潜在粒子。基于深度潜在粒子（DLP）框架，每个粒子编码了解耦的属性，包括3D关键点位置、边界框尺寸和外观特征，并代表场景中的一个独立实体。该模型通过端到端的自监督重建目标学习可解释的逐粒子分割图。我们在模拟和真实世界数据集上证明，所学习的潜在空间具有可解释性和可控性：通过操纵粒子位置并进行解码，我们可以生成新颖的场景配置。此外，我们展示了将这些紧凑的3D潜在粒子用于下游机器人操作任务，能够提升相较于基线的性能——这些基线要么缺乏显式3D信息，要么依赖缺乏对象中心结构的、内存密集型的密集3D输入。代码和视频可在https://eubooks3003.github.io/3d-dlp获取。

Authors: Ellina Zhang, Madhaven Iyengar, Amir Zadeh, Chuan Li, Deepak Pathak, David Held, Tal Daniel

Lagrange: An Open-Vocabulary, Energy-Based Sparse Framework for Generalized End-to-End Driving AutonomousDriving

open-vocabulary driving Masked Latent Fields energy-based planning intent-driven cross-attention end-to-end autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出Lagrange，一种基于掩码潜在场和视觉语言模型的开词汇驾驶框架，通过连续能量场实现运动学可行、无碰撞的轨迹规划，并在nuScenes和CODA基准上进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper proposes Lagrange, an open-vocabulary driving framework using Masked Latent Fields and Vision-Language Models to produce continuous energy fields for kinematically feasible, collision-free trajectory planning, evaluated on nuScenes and CODA benchmarks.

Abstract: Scaling end-to-end autonomous driving to complex, open-world environments requires perceptual models that generalize to anomalous scenarios and planners that produce kinematically valid trajectories. Existing paradigms face a distinct dichotomy between representational efficiency and generalization capacity. Dense models (e.g., occupancy networks), while geometrically robust, incur critical computational bottlenecks and struggle with high-level semantic reasoning. Conversely, sparse, query-based planners are efficient but reliant on closed-set definitions, rendering them vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) events. Although recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer open-vocabulary reasoning, their autoregressive, discrete token generation fundamentally conflicts with the continuous, high-frequency control requirements of vehicle dynamics. To address this, we propose Lagrange, an open-vocabulary, computationally sparse driving framework based on Masked Latent Fields (MLF). Rather than relying on dense volumetric reconstructions or closed-set query mechanisms, Lagrange exploits Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to encode class-agnostic object proposals into continuous semantic visual tokens. We introduce an intent-driven masked cross-attention module that temporally filters irrelevant entities, decoding the attended tokens into an implicit continuous energy field defined over spatial coordinates. By framing decision-making as a Lagrangian action minimization problem spanning this energy field, we enforce strict compliance with vehicle kinematics while executing collision avoidance. Extensive offline evaluations on both standard (nuScenes) and long-tail (CODA) benchmarks demonstrate that Lagrange establishes a promising framework for robust, interpretable, and kinematically feasible open-world autonomy.

摘要（中文）：将端到端自动驾驶扩展到复杂、开放的世界环境中，需要能够泛化到异常场景的感知模型以及能生成运动学有效轨迹的规划器。现有范式在表示效率与泛化能力之间存在明显对立。稠密模型（如占据网络）虽几何稳健性较强，但存在严重的计算瓶颈，且难以进行高层语义推理。相反，稀疏的基于查询的规划器效率较高，但依赖封闭集定义，导致其对分布外事件缺乏鲁棒性。尽管近期视觉-语言-动作模型具备开放词汇推理能力，但其自回归离散令牌生成方式与车辆动力学所需的连续高频控制要求存在根本性冲突。为此，我们提出Lagrange框架——一种基于掩码潜场的开放词汇、计算稀疏型驾驶框架。该框架不依赖稠密体积重建或封闭集查询机制，而是利用视觉-语言模型将类别无关的物体提议编码为连续语义视觉令牌。我们引入意图驱动的掩码交叉注意力模块，在时间维度上过滤无关实体，并将所关注的令牌解码为定义在空间坐标上的隐式连续能量场。通过将决策制定建模为该能量场上的拉格朗日作用量最小化问题，我们在执行碰撞规避的同时严格保障车辆运动学约束。在标准基准（nuScenes）与长尾基准（CODA）上的大量离线评估表明，Lagrange为鲁棒、可解释且运动学可行的开放世界自主驾驶建立了富有前景的框架。

Authors: Shihao Ji, HongXi Li, Zihui Song, Mingyu Li

Sensorimotor World Models: Perception for Action via Inverse Dynamics WorldModel

latent world model inverse dynamics regularization action-aligned representations representation collapse prevention planning

简要说明：一种通过逆动力学正则化进行端到端训练的潜世界模型，以防止表示坍缩并产生与动作对齐的表示，用于规划。

TLDR: A latent world model trained end-to-end with inverse dynamics regularization to prevent representation collapse and produce action-aligned representations for planning.

Abstract: Perception for action suggests that representations of the world should be shaped not by visual fidelity alone, but by their relevance for actions. At the same time, latent JEPA-style world models advocate learning compact predictive states from high-dimensional observations to facilitate the prediction of future states, but end-to-end training of these models is nontrivial because representations may collapse if our only goal is to construct a latent state that is easy to predict. We introduce a sensorimotor world model (SMWM): a latent world model trained end-to-end with inverse dynamics regularization. This single regularizer addresses both issues: it prevents representation collapse and induces action-aligned representations. By forcing latent states to preserve information about the action underlying a transition, it biases the model toward the controllable degrees of freedom of the environment while discarding uncontrollable distractors. This yields stable latent world models trained from offline, reward-free trajectories, without frozen encoders, exponential moving averages, or complex latent regularizers. Empirically, SMWM learns compact, interpretable latent spaces and enables competitive planning performance across simple 2D and 3D control tasks.

摘要（中文）：面向行动感知表明，世界表征不应仅由视觉保真度塑造，更应依据其与行动的相关性来形成。与此同时，潜在JEPA风格的世界模型倡导从高维观测中学习紧凑的预测状态，以促进未来状态的预测，但这类模型的端到端训练并非易事——若我们的唯一目标是构建易于预测的潜在状态，表征可能发生坍塌。我们提出一种感觉运动世界模型（SMWM）：一种通过逆动力学正则化进行端到端训练的潜在世界模型。这一单一正则化项同时解决两个问题：它既防止表征坍塌，又诱导出与行动对齐的表征。通过强制潜在状态保留转换过程中底层行动的信息，该模型倾向于关注环境中可控的自由度，同时摒弃不可控的干扰因素。这使我们能够从离线、无奖励的轨迹中训练出稳定的潜在世界模型，无需冻结编码器、指数移动平均或复杂的潜在正则化项。实验表明，SMWM能够学习紧凑且可解释的潜在空间，并在简单的2D和3D控制任务中实现具有竞争力的规划性能。

Authors: Petr Ivashkov, Randall Balestriero, Bernhard Schölkopf

Advancing DialNav through Automatic Embodied Dialog Augmentation VLN

DialNav embodied dialog augmentation vision-and-language navigation dual-strategy training localization model

简要说明：本文提出了一种自动对话增强流水线，为对话导航任务构建大规模训练数据集RAINbow，并设计了双策略训练方案和定位模型，在导航成功率上取得了显著提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces an automatic dialogue augmentation pipeline to create a large-scale training dataset (RAINbow) for the Dialog-Navigation (DialNav) task, along with a dual-strategy training scheme and a localization model, achieving significant improvements in navigation success rates.

Abstract: For embodied agents capable of physical interaction, the capability to create and understand dialog is crucial to ensure both safety and effectiveness. While DialNav~\cite{han2025dialnav} provides a framework for holistic evaluation of the dialog--execution loop in photorealistic indoor navigation, its performance remains limited by a critical scarcity of training data (2K episodes). To address this, we propose an automatic generation pipeline, and construct the \textbf{RAINbow} dataset, a large-scale training dataset with 238K episodes for DialNav. Our pipeline converts existing VLN datasets into multi-turn dialog and creates cost-efficient and high-quality dataset. Then, we introduce two additional complementary advances to unlock the data's full potential: (1) Dual-Strategy Training, a navigation training scheme to align the navigation training with the dynamic dialog-navigation loop, and (2) a localization model that leverages VLN knowledge. By combining these complementary solutions, our model substantially outperforms the baseline in success rate on both \textbf{Val Seen} (58.24, \textbf{+89\%}) and \textbf{Val Unseen} (29.05, \textbf{+100\%}) splits, establishing a new state of the art.

摘要（中文）：对于具备物理交互能力的具身智能体而言，创建并理解对话的能力对于确保安全性和有效性至关重要。尽管DialNav~\cite{han2025dialnav}为照片级室内导航中的对话-执行循环提供了整体评估框架，但其性能仍受限于训练数据的严重匮乏（仅2000个片段）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种自动生成流程，并构建了\textbf{RAINbow}数据集——包含23.8万个片段的DialNav大规模训练数据集。该流程将现有视觉语言导航（VLN）数据集转化为多轮对话，从而创建出高性价比、高质量的数据库。随后，我们引入两项互补性技术突破以充分释放数据潜力：（1）双策略训练——一种将导航训练与动态对话-导航循环对齐的训练方案；（2）利用VLN知识的定位模型。通过整合这些互补方案，我们的模型在\textbf{Val Seen}（58.24，\textbf{+89\%}）和\textbf{Val Unseen}（29.05，\textbf{+100\%}）两个数据分割上的成功率均大幅超越基线模型，创造了新的最佳性能记录。

Authors: Leekyeung Han, Sangwon Jung, Hyunji Min, Jinseong Jeong, Minyoung Kim, Paul Hongsuck Seo

Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core WorldModel

persistent state world model benchmark camera motion intervention world-state evolution observability

简要说明：本文提出了WRBench基准测试，揭示了当前世界模型的一个根本缺陷：它们缺乏在相机未观察时持续演化的持久状态，行为更像跟踪镜头。作者主张将世界状态的演化作为世界模型设计的第一类目标。

TLDR: This paper introduces WRBench, a benchmark that reveals a fundamental failure of current world models: they lack a persistent state that evolves when the camera is not observing, instead behaving like a tracking shot. The authors argue for making world-state evolution a first-class design objective.

Abstract: World models are increasingly regarded as a decisive step toward artificial general intelligence, yet modeling the physical world demands more than rendering convincing frames on demand: it requires an internal world state that keeps evolving over time, decoupled from observation, so that objects endure and events run to their conclusions whether or not a camera is watching, much as the moon holds to its orbit when no one is looking. This requirement is a blind spot of existing benchmarks, which reward surface properties such as fidelity, motion, and camera controllability while never asking whether a generated world keeps evolving once it is unobserved. We introduce \textbf{WRBench}, the first systematic diagnostic benchmark that treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and resolves evaluation into a human-calibrated chain that asks whether the camera executes the requested interaction, whether the scene stays continuous and identifiable while in view, and whether a returning target remains consistent with the event that was set in motion. Across 9{,}600 videos from 23 models spanning four control paradigms, one finding proves stubborn: current systems maintain the observed world as a tracking shot, resuming a returning target in the state at which it was abandoned rather than advancing the event while it went unseen. Because this failure recurs across control paradigms, model families, and increments of scale, robust world-state evolution does not follow from cleaner imagery, tighter control, richer geometric priors, or sheer parameter count We therefore argue that the stability of the physical state kernel and the consistency of worldlines under viewpoint intervention should become first-class objectives of world-model design, so that a world model captures how the world will unfold rather than how the next frame appears.

摘要（中文）：世界模型日益被视为迈向通用人工智能的关键一步，然而对物理世界进行建模，其要求远不止按需生成令人信服的帧画面：它需要一种能随时间持续演进、与观测解耦的内部世界状态，使得物体具有持久性，事件能够推进至其终结——无论是否有摄像头在观测，正如月亮即便无人仰望，也依然沿着轨道运行。这一要求是现有基准测试的盲区，因为它们奖励的是保真度、运动、相机可控性等表面属性，却从未追问：生成的场景在未被观测时是否仍在持续演进。我们提出\textbf{WRBench}，这是首个系统性的诊断基准，将相机运动视为对可观测性的干预，并将评估分解为经过人工校准的推理链：依次检验相机是否执行了所要求的交互操作、场景在视野内是否保持连续且可识别、以及返回的目标是否与已启动的事件状态保持一致性。通过对涵盖四种控制范式的23个模型生成的9600个视频进行分析，一个结论顽固地浮现：当前系统仅将所观测的世界维持为一个跟拍镜头——当目标重新进入视野时，系统恢复的是其被遗弃时的状态，而非推进其未被观测期间的事件演进。由于这一缺陷存在于不同控制范式、模型家族和规模增长之中，稳健的世界状态演进并不能通过更清晰的图像、更精确的控制、更丰富的几何先验或单纯的参数规模获得。因此我们认为，物理状态核的稳定性以及视角干预下世界线的连贯性，应成为世界模型设计的一级目标，从而使世界模型捕捉的是世界如何展开，而非下一帧画面如何呈现。

Authors: Jinpeng Lu, Dexu Zhu, Haoyuan Shi, Linghan Cai, Guo Tang, Yinda Chen, Jie Cao, Duyu Tang, Yi Zhang, Yong Dai, Xiaozhu Ju

Holo-World: Unified Camera, Object and Weather Control for Video World Model WorldModel

video world model camera control object control weather transfer unified scene adapter

简要说明：Holo-World 是一个视频世界模型，能够从单张图像联合控制相机运动、物体运动和天气，通过统一场景适配器和场景-天气分解CFG实现世界保持和天气转移。

TLDR: Holo-World is a video world model that jointly controls camera motion, object motion, and weather from a single image, using a Unified Scene Adapter and Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG to enable both world preservation and weather transfer.

Abstract: Video world models are moving toward preserving an observed world under controllable camera and object motion while allowing its environmental state to change. Yet these controls remain isolated, and weather generation typically relies on a source video or reconstructed scene that already specifies future structure. We study a first-frame-anchored source-to-state setting, where the model starts from a single image and follows explicit camera and object controls and an optional weather instruction, then generates a video that either preserves the source world or transfers it to a target weather state. To address these challenges, we first build HoloStateData, a state video dataset that turns diverse videos into unified control samples for camera, object, and weather supervision. Second, we introduce Holo-World, a unified controllable video world model that jointly controls scene from a single image. Its Unified Scene Adapter factorizes world preservation and weather transfer into distinct parameter subspaces, using rendered background, geometry buffers, and object controls to maintain controlled scene structure while modeling weather-dependent appearance and particle effects. Additionally, Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG guides scene and weather residuals separately, strengthening target weather effects without over-amplifying the full condition. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that Holo-World maintains precise camera and object control with consistent scene structure while transferring scenes into diverse target weather state, outperforming video-to-video weather editing baselines on weather-state generation. Our project page is available at \url{https://xiangchenyin.github.io/Holo-World/}.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型正朝着在可控相机与物体运动下保留观测世界的同时，允许其环境状态变化的方向发展。然而，这些控制手段目前仍相互孤立，且天气生成通常依赖于已预设未来结构的源视频或重建场景。我们研究了一种以首帧锚定的源到状态设置，模型从单张图像出发，遵循明确的相机与物体控制指令及可选的天气指令，生成保留源世界或将其转换至目标天气状态的视频。为解决这些挑战，我们首先构建了HoloStateData——一个状态视频数据集，将多样化的视频转化为统一的相机、物体与天气监督控制样本。其次，我们提出Holo-World，一个统一的可控视频世界模型，可从单张图像联合控制场景。其统一场景适配器将世界保留与天气转换分解为不同的参数子空间，利用渲染背景、几何缓冲与物体控制来维持可控场景结构，同时建模依赖于天气的外观与粒子特效。此外，场景-天气解耦CFG分别引导场景与天气残差，在不过度放大整体条件的前提下增强目标天气效果。定量与定性实验表明，Holo-World在保持精确相机与物体控制及一致场景结构的同时，能将场景转换至多种目标天气状态，在天气状态生成任务上优于视频到视频的天气编辑基线。项目页面访问地址：\url{https://xiangchenyin.github.io/Holo-World/}。

Authors: Xiangchen Yin, Wenzhang Sun, Jiahui Yuan, Zijie Liu, Yinda Chen, Wei Li, Dachun Kai, Chunfeng Wang, Xiaoyan Sun

TaCauchy: An Extensible FEM Framework for Vision-Based Tactile Simulation Other

Finite Element Method vision-based tactile sensor Isaac Sim Cauchy stress tensor robotic manipulation

简要说明：TaCauchy 是一个基于有限元方法的触觉仿真框架，集成于 Isaac Sim，能够从第一性原理计算柯西应力张量和牵引力，与真实传感器的 SSIM 达到 0.93 以上。

TLDR: TaCauchy is an FEM-based tactile simulation framework for Isaac Sim that computes physically accurate Cauchy stress tensors and traction forces, achieving over 0.93 SSIM agreement with real sensors.

Abstract: Vision-based tactile sensors require high-fidelity simulation for reinforcement learning, yet existing approaches struggle to provide accurate mechanical stress fields within GPU-accelerated robotics platforms. We present TaCauchy, an extensible Finite Element Method (FEM) framework that integrates rigorous physics-based force computation into Isaac Sim. Built on the Unified Incremental Potential Contact (UIPC) solver, TaCauchy directly computes Cauchy stress tensors from hyperelastic constitutive laws and projects them onto contact surfaces to obtain traction forces and pressure distributions, providing mechanical ground truth from first principles rather than empirical estimation. Our framework features automatic mesh generation with geometry-aware adaptive refinement and a modular sensor interface enabling rapid integration of diverse sensors (GelSight Mini, DIGIT, 9DTact) with minimal configuration. Performance benchmarks demonstrate 33.40 FPS for single environments and 555 FPS aggregate throughput across 60 parallel environments, with stress extraction overhead under 1 ms. Physical validation experiments show strong agreement between simulated and real tactile responses across force ranges from 1.2556 N to 4.7332 N, achieving SSIM above 0.93, confirming the framework's capability to provide accurate, physically-grounded force supervision for downstream robotic manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的触觉传感器在强化学习中需要高保真仿真，但现有方法难以在GPU加速的机器人平台上提供精确的力学应力场。我们提出TaCauchy框架——一个可扩展的有限元法（FEM）框架，将基于物理的严格力计算集成至Isaac Sim中。该框架基于统一增量势接触（UIPC）求解器构建，直接从超弹性本构方程计算柯西应力张量，并将其投影至接触表面以获取牵引力与压力分布，从而从第一性原理而非经验估计出发提供力学真实解。我们的框架具备几何感知自适应细化的自动网格生成功能，以及模块化传感器接口，能够以最小配置快速集成多种传感器（GelSight Mini、DIGIT、9DTact）。性能基准测试显示，单环境运行帧率达33.40 FPS，60个并行环境总吞吐量达555 FPS，应力提取开销低于1毫秒。物理验证实验表明，在1.2556 N至4.7332 N力范围内，仿真与真实触觉响应高度吻合，结构相似性指数（SSIM）超过0.93，证实了该框架能够为下游机器人操作任务提供精确且基于物理的力监督信息。

Authors: Hengfei Zhao, Yifan Xie, Junhao Gong, Yue Sun, Kai Zhu, Weihua He, Shoujie Li, Haohuan Fu, Wenbo Ding

Stable Transformer-Actor-Critic Model Predictive Control: A Contraction Analysis Approach RLRobot

Transformer-Actor-Critic Model Predictive Control contraction analysis δISS drone control

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于收缩理论和δISS的Transformer-Actor-Critic MPC架构，具有形式化的鲁棒性保证，并在三维无人机控制任务上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Transformer-Actor-Critic MPC architecture with formal robustness guarantees based on contraction theory and δISS, validated on a 3D drone control task.

Abstract: Actor-Critic Model Predictive Control (MPC) effectively addresses complex, non-convex control problems, but guaranteeing the closed-loop stability of sequence-based learning models within these pipelines remains challenging. This paper introduces a novel Transformer-Actor-Critic MPC architecture with formal robustness guarantees. First, we prove that Transformer networks can satisfy global incremental Input-to-State Stability ($δ$ISS). We then leverage Riemannian contraction theory to analyze the interconnected dynamics between the physical plant and the predictive neural network. Finally, we integrate these theoretical bounds as a training regularizer to yield a certifiably robust policy. The framework is validated on a nonlinear 3D drone model executing target-reaching and obstacle-avoidance maneuvers.

摘要（中文）：Actor-Critic模型预测控制（MPC）有效解决了复杂的非凸控制问题，但如何保证基于序列的学习模型在此类框架中的闭环稳定性仍具挑战。本文提出了一种具有形式化鲁棒性保证的新型Transformer-Actor-Critic MPC架构。首先，我们证明了Transformer网络能够满足全局增量输入-状态稳定性（$δ$ISS）。随后，利用黎曼收缩理论分析物理被控对象与预测神经网络之间的互联动态特性。最后，将上述理论界限作为训练正则化项进行集成，从而获得可认证的鲁棒策略。该框架在实现目标到达与避障机动任务的非线性三维无人机模型上得到了验证。

Authors: Antonio Marino, Valerio Modugno, Marco Cognetti

VFILC: Accurate Frequency Extrapolations in Imitation Learning via Sampling Frequency ILC Manipulation

variable-frequency imitation learning iterative learning control frequency extrapolation robot motion imitation learning

简要说明：提出VFILC方法，将变频模仿学习与迭代学习控制相结合，在模仿学习中实现精确的频率外推，支持机器人变速运动。

TLDR: Proposes VFILC, combining variable-frequency imitation learning with iterative learning control to enable accurate frequency extrapolation in imitation learning for variable-speed robot motions.

Abstract: Conventional neural network (NN)-based imitation learning methods for variable-speed motion either restricted their scope to interpolated speeds, or generated unpredictable motions when extrapolating beyond trained velocity ranges. Variable-frequency imitation learning (VFIL) enabled extrapolations of speeds by linking the NN model's sampling frequency to the motion frequency, whereas its open-loop configuration caused frequency errors, especially in the extrapolated high-frequency settings. This study proposes variable-frequency imitation learning with iterative learning control (VFILC) based on a combination of VFIL and iterative learning control (ILC) with both feedforward and feedback parts, the former taking advantage of VFIL and the latter adjusting the frequency errors. The experimental results showed that the proposed method successfully and accurately extrapolated motion speeds and reduced frequency errors in all three tasks, and that the feedback especially reduced the frequency errors by a remarkable 81% in the wiping task and 50% in the shaking task, both compared to simple feedforward VFIL, when extrapolating at double the average speed in the training data. The proposed method also improved accuracy by 27% compared with VFIL even at an interpolated frequency for a contact-rich mixing task affected by complex friction traits.

摘要（中文）：基于传统神经网络（NN）的模仿学习方法用于变速运动时，要么将适用范围限制在内插速度，要么在超出训练速度范围进行外推时产生不可预测的运动。变频模仿学习（VFIL）通过将神经网络模型的采样频率与运动频率相关联，实现了速度的外推，但其开环配置会导致频率误差，尤其是在外推高频设定下尤为显著。本研究提出基于变频模仿学习与迭代学习控制相结合的方法（VFILC），该方法整合了前馈与反馈两部分：前馈部分利用VFIL的优势，反馈部分对频率误差进行调节。实验结果表明，所提方法在全部三项任务中均能成功且准确地外推运动速度，并有效降低频率误差。与简单前馈VFIL相比，反馈部分在擦拭任务和摇晃任务中以训练数据平均速度两倍进行外推时，分别将频率误差显著降低81%和50%。即使在受复杂摩擦特性影响的接触密集型混合任务的内插频率条件下，所提方法相比VFIL的精度也提升了27%。

Authors: Nozomu Masuya, Toshiaki Tsuji, Sho Sakaino

A Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Efficient Pathfinding in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems RLRobot

neuromorphic computing spiking neural network reinforcement learning pathfinding robotic mobile fulfillment

简要说明：SDQN-RMFS是一个端到端框架，将强化学习策略从全精度ANN转换为脉冲神经网络，在神经形态硬件上实现超低功耗、低延迟的路径规划，在机器人移动货架系统中实现了巨大的节能效果。

TLDR: SDQN-RMFS is an end-to-end framework that converts a reinforcement learning policy from a full-precision ANN to a spiking neural network for ultra-low-power, low-latency pathfinding on neuromorphic hardware, achieving massive energy savings in robotic mobile fulfillment systems.

Abstract: Dynamic environmental changes, confined workspaces, and stringent real-time constraints make pathfinding in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems (RMFS) a challenging problem for conventional search- and rule-based methods, which typically suffer from high computational complexity and long decision latency. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful alternative, deploying learned policies with extreme energy efficiency on resource-constrained hardware remains an open challenge. We present SDQN-RMFS, an end-to-end framework that achieves high-fidelity deployment of an RL-trained policy from a full-precision artificial neural network (ANN) through to a neuromorphic chip. By computing only when triggered by sparse events, this framework unlocks ultra-low-power RMFS pathfinding. Our full-stack pipeline operates as follows: an ANN policy is first efficiently trained via a collision-allowing strategy to densify informative trajectories, and then converted into a spiking neural network (SNN) via a hard-label knowledge distillation approach. This effectively addresses the output distribution mismatch, preserving policy capability across the ANN-to-SNN pipeline while substantially reducing inference latency. Hardware experiments demonstrate up to 11,281$\times$ energy savings and a nearly two-fold reduction in latency compared to a high-performance GPU baseline, while maintaining decision quality on par with the original trained policy. These results establish physical neuromorphic inference as a practical and energy-sustainable pathway for large-scale RMFS operations.

摘要（中文）：动态环境变化、受限工作空间以及严苛的实时性约束，使得传统基于搜索与规则的方法在机器人移动订单履行系统（RMFS）的路径规划中面临严峻挑战——这类方法通常存在计算复杂度高、决策延迟长的问题。尽管强化学习（RL）已成为一种强大的替代方案，但在资源受限的硬件上以极致能效部署学习到的策略仍是一个开放性难题。我们提出SDQN-RMFS，这是一个端到端框架，能够将经过强化学习训练的全精度人工神经网络（ANN）策略高保真地部署至神经形态芯片。该框架仅由稀疏事件触发计算，从而实现了超低功耗的RMFS路径规划。我们的全栈流水线流程如下：首先通过允许碰撞的策略高效训练ANN策略以增密信息丰富的轨迹，随后通过硬标签知识蒸馏方法将其转换为脉冲神经网络（SNN）。该方法有效解决了输出分布不匹配问题，在保持ANN-SNN转换流水线中策略性能的同时显著降低推理延迟。硬件实验表明，与高性能GPU基线相比，该方法实现了高达11281倍的能耗节省，延迟降低近两倍，同时保持了与原训练策略相当的决策质量。这些结果证明了物理神经形态推理作为大规模RMFS运营的可持续节能路径的实用性。

Authors: Junzhe Xu, Zecui Zeng, Lusong Li, Yuetong Fang, Renjing Xu

Deep-Unfolded Coordination Other

deep unfolding distributed optimization ADMM-DDP multi-agent robotics trajectory optimization

简要说明：提出一种深度展开框架，在求解时自适应调整ADMM-DDP分布式优化器的惩罚参数，实现多机器人系统轨迹生成速度提升6-9倍，并泛化至更大规模的机器人集群。

TLDR: A deep-unfolding framework that learns to adapt penalty parameters of the ADMM-DDP distributed optimizer at solve-time, achieving 6-9x faster trajectory generation for multi-robot systems while generalizing to larger fleets.

Abstract: Distributed optimization is a highly scalable and structurally transparent technique to solve multi-agent robotics problems; however, such methods often suffer from the need for highly-specialized, problem-specific hyperparameter tunings. In this work, we propose Deep Coordinator, a deep-unfolding framework that learns to dynamically adjust the hyperparameters of ADMM-DDP, a popular distributed solver for robotics tasks, at solve-time in response to optimizer performance. Our architecture consists of unrolling a fixed number of ADMM-DDP iterations into a neural network with learnable functions between layers mapping the optimizer state to the next hyperparameters. To the best of our knowledge, Deep Coordinator is the first deep-unfolding framework to adapt the penalty parameters of a non-convex optimizer at solve-time; we show that the mainstream supervised approach can yield degenerate solutions when training such models, and propose an unsupervised learning scheme. On simulations with fleets of cars and quadrotors, Deep Coordinator produces trajectories of comparable quality 6.18-9.44x faster than conventional solvers. Furthermore, Deep Coordinator retains its performance benefits when deployed to systems up to 8x larger than trained on.

摘要（中文）：分布式优化是一种高度可扩展且结构透明的技术，用于解决多智能体机器人问题；然而，此类方法通常需要针对特定问题进行高度专业化的超参数调优。本文提出深度协调器（Deep Coordinator），这是一种深度展开框架，能够在求解过程中根据优化器性能动态调整ADMM-DDP（一种机器人领域常用的分布式求解器）的超参数。该架构将固定次数的ADMM-DDP迭代展开为神经网络，层间设置可学习函数，用于将优化器状态映射至下一组超参数。据我们所知，深度协调器是首个在求解过程中自适应调整非凸优化器惩罚参数的深度展开框架；我们证明，主流监督学习方法在训练此类模型时可能产生退化解，并据此提出无监督学习方案。在汽车与四旋翼机群的仿真实验中，深度协调器生成轨迹的质量与传统求解器相当，但速度提升6.18-9.44倍。此外，当部署至训练规模8倍的系统时，深度协调器仍能保持其性能优势。

Authors: Hunter Kuperman, Minchan Jung, Rahul V. Ghosh, Alex Oshin, Evangelos A. Theodorou

Safe, Real-Time Active Model Discrimination and Fault Diagnosis for Nonlinear Systems via Differentiable Reachability Other

fault diagnosis model discrimination differentiable reachability nonlinear systems real-time safety

简要说明：一种基于可微可达性的实时安全主动故障诊断算法，在四旋翼、战斗机、差速驱动机器人和四足导航等机器人平台上得到验证。

TLDR: A real-time, safe algorithm for active fault diagnosis in nonlinear systems using differentiable reachability, validated on robotic platforms including quadrotors, fighter jets, differential-drive robots, and quadrupedal navigation.

Abstract: We present a safe, real-time algorithm for active fault diagnosis and model discrimination for uncertain continuous-time nonlinear systems with process and measurement disturbances. Given a finite set of candidate models representing nominal and faulty modes, including actuator and sensor faults, we formulate an output-feedback, time-varying policy optimization problem that (i) robustly enforces state-input safety constraints over a finite horizon and (ii) drives the system to produce sampled measurements consistent with at most one model, enabling deterministic diagnosis. To solve this problem in real time, we develop a tractable approximation using interval over-approximations of reachable state and output sets, and encode diagnosability via a differentiable objective that penalizes overlap between the reachable output sets of possible models. The resulting optimization is solved efficiently online with gradient-based methods using JAX and differentiable reachability primitives. We evaluate our method on sensor and actuator fault diagnosis (up to 11 fault modes) in several high-dimensional nonlinear robotic systems, including a simulated quadrotor and fighter-jet model, a hardware differential-drive robot, and quadrupedal navigation. Across these case studies, our approach achieves reliable model discrimination in under 50 ms, outperforming baselines in discrimination success rate and speed while providing formal safety guarantees.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种安全、实时的主动故障诊断与模型区分算法，适用于存在过程与测量扰动的连续时间不确定非线性系统。给定一组有限的候选模型（代表标称模式与故障模式，包括执行器与传感器故障），我们构建了一个输出反馈、时变策略优化问题，该问题能够：(i) 在有限时域内鲁棒地满足状态-输入安全约束；(ii) 驱动系统产生采样测量值，使其仅与至多一个模型一致，从而实现确定性诊断。为实时求解该问题，我们开发了一种可处理的近似方法，利用可达状态与输出集合的区间过近似，并通过可微目标函数（惩罚可能模型的可达输出集之间的重叠）来编码可诊断性。最终优化问题通过基于梯度的算法在线高效求解，使用了JAX与可微可达性原语。我们在多个高维非线性机器人系统（包括仿真四旋翼与战斗机模型、硬件差速驱动机器人以及四足机器人导航）上，针对传感器与执行器故障诊断（最多11种故障模式）评估了该方法。在各项案例研究中，我们的方法在50毫秒内实现了可靠的模型区分，在区分成功率与速度上优于基线方法，同时提供了形式化的安全保证。

CRAX: Fast Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmarking RLRobot

safe reinforcement learning benchmark MuJoCo XLA hardware acceleration constrained RL

简要说明：CRAX是一种基于MuJoCo XLA的快速约束RL基准测试，相比基于CPU的安全基准实现了约100倍加速，包含六个环境套件，并评估了六种安全RL方法，适用于机器人和自动驾驶等现实领域。

TLDR: CRAX is a fast constrained RL benchmark built on MuJoCo XLA that achieves ~100x speedup over CPU-based safety benchmarks, featuring six environment suites and evaluating six safe RL methods for real-world domains like robotics and autonomous driving.

Abstract: Safety is a core concern for deploying reinforcement learning (RL) agents in real-world domains such as robotics and autonomous driving. While benchmarks have been central to progress in RL, existing safety benchmarks with high-fidelity 3D physics remain computationally slow, limiting large-scale experimentation and rapid prototyping. To address this gap, we propose CRAX (Constrained RL Accelerated with JAX). Built on top of the MuJoCo XLA (MJX) physics engine with realistic 3D dynamics, CRAX leverages vectorized operations and hardware acceleration, yielding up to ~100x speedups over comparable CPU-based safety benchmarks. The benchmark features six environment suites and three agent-specific tasks, each spanning three difficulty levels. Evaluating six popular safe RL methods shows that no single approach dominates across all tasks, and reveals the trade-offs between performance and safety. We find that curriculum learning across difficulty levels and safety transfer can improve performance over direct training in harder settings.

摘要（中文）：**摘要：** 安全性是在机器人、自动驾驶等真实世界领域部署强化学习（RL）智能体的核心关注点。尽管基准测试推动了强化学习的发展，但现有具备高保真三维物理特性的安全基准测试在计算上仍较为缓慢，限制了大规模实验和快速原型开发。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了CRAX（基于JAX的加速约束强化学习框架）。该框架构建于具备真实三维动力学的MuJoCo XLA（MJX）物理引擎之上，利用向量化操作与硬件加速，相较于基于CPU的同类安全基准测试，实现了高达约100倍的加速。该基准测试包含六个环境套件和三个智能体专属任务，每个任务均涵盖三个难度等级。对六种主流安全强化学习方法的评估表明，没有任何单一方法在所有任务中占据主导地位，并揭示了性能与安全性之间的权衡关系。我们还发现，跨难度级别的课程学习与安全迁移能够在高难度设定下提升性能表现。
